articles.title: Anthropic claims popular Chinese AI model has Mythos-class hacking abilities
articles.text:
Anthropic claims popular Chinese AI model has Mythos-class hacking abilities — frontier red teaming report details weak safeguards on open-weight AI
Zhipu AI's GLM-5.3 goes under Anthropic's microscope.
Anthropic has released a new report, claiming that Zhipu AI's GLM-5.3 AI model can be used to generate malicious content, with weak safeguarding. The company claims that the AI model can be used for cyberattacks, and that its safeguards can be bypassed using several methods.
Anthropic's report comes amidst a chorus of calls for a slowdown of AI development, with the company seeking governance and regulation. Despite CEO Dario Amodei's calls for pacing the AI frontier, Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5.5 were released just days after alarms were raised.
Now, the closed-source AI company, which is currently eyeing an IPO, says that Chinese open-weight models can be abused and can generate harmful content. Anthropic cites the Center for AI Standards and Innovation's own report, published in late September, which claims that GLM-5.3 can fully automate exploits on a similar level to Anthropic's own unreleased Claude Mythos AI model, which spurred the company to develop Project Glasswing, an effort that gives developers access to a Mythos-class AI model to patch bugs and to fix vulnerabilities before such AI models are released.
Anthropic ran its own benchmarks on GLM-5.3 in Exploitbench, where AI models, in a sandboxed environment, can develop exploits for Google Chrome. GLM-5.3 developed end-to-end exploits 50 times in 410 runs, with Mythos leading the pack with 56 successful exploits in 410 attempts. Zhipu AI's model was further tested in one of Anthropic's internal benchmarks, which targets the development of "full control-flow hijacks". GLM 5.3 performed just below Mythos once more, with a 4% success rate, compared to Mythos' 6%. Notably, other popular open-weight models such as Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash attained 0% by the same measures.
Anthropic further notes how GLM-5.3 was able to successfully develop chained exploits autonomously, with its lighter "Flash" variant also having the ability to develop chained exploits in known bugs, at a tokenized price of just $20.40. Depending on the balance, that equates to GLM-5.3-Flash having the ability to develop (known) chained exploits using anywhere from 100-300 million tokens, depending on the ratio of inputs to outputs.
Anthropic also notes that using the stock GLM-5.3 AI model, it was simple to dodge the model's guardrails through various methods. The company details that this can be done through two methods: offering a deceptive prompt, where the AI role-plays an adversarial autonomous agent, which results in a 64% success rate, and prefilling the model's thinking tokens to ensure that a response proceeds, which results in a 92% success rate. The company also detailed a third method, known as abliteration.
Abliterating guardrails
Anthropic alleges that Zhipu AI's GLM-5.3 has weak safeguards, and that the stock AI model often refuses requests to generate harmful content. However, since Anthropic develops closed-source models, its products cannot be tinkered with. Because GLM-5.3 is freely downloadable, the model can be tweaked with its guardrails wholesale removed. When treated as the officially released model, GLM-5.3 achieves a refusal rate on par with Anthropic models.
However, Anthropic "abliterated" GLM-5.3, which purposefully removes model guardrails, and displayed how, after abliteration, the model's refusal rate drops to just 6% for GLM-5.3 and 14% for GLM-5.3-Flash. It's not uncommon to encounter abliterated open-weight models on HuggingFace, which are primarily developed to assist in simulated red teaming environments, but they can also be used for real-world attacks. This makes Anthropic's 'discovery' less surprising.
In addition, it would take an enormous amount of compute power to run an abliterated version of GLM-5.3 at a workable level. The model's weights demand 306 GB of VRAM at full-precision FP8 weights, and you should expect to allocate a similar amount of VRAM for KV cache to carry context. Running the model at an estimated 100 TPS not only requires a minimum memory bandwidth of 4 TB/s, but it would also demand powerful silicon, like a cluster of eight Nvidia H200 AI accelerators. The money required for that kind of hardware stretches into the hundreds of thousands. Adversarial nation-state actors may be able to utilize such a setup, should they acquire the hardware.
For the ordinary everyday bedroom hacker, though? You'd likely need to rent the compute, abliterate the model, and then run it, which is also incredibly expensive. Anthropic says that abliterating the model GLM-5.3-Flash took 2,200 GPU hours, which they estimate costs $4,400, or around $2 per GPU hour, which aligns with the hardware rentals required.
Renting enough GPUs to abliterate the full-fat GLM-5.3 would cost around $30 per hour, according to figures from Runpod, where rental of a single H200 costs $3.79 per hour; you'd need eight. Generating around 100 million tokens would cost $8,422 and take 11 and a half days, at a hypothetical 100 TPS using eight H200 NVL GPUs. Abliterating the model itself, running it, and generating a working cyberattack would likely take much more time and would be incredibly expensive, which may perhaps be the biggest hurdle for any would-be malicious actors.
Why is Anthropic focused on this?
Given the current uproar around AI safety, Anthropic is highlighting the existential threats posed by frontier open-weight AI models as their capabilities continue to improve. While President Trump has met with leading figures in AI to self-regulate future model releases, Anthropic's post can be read in such a way that it spurs developers and governments to test open-weight models for their capabilities.
It could also reflect a growing anti-open-weight sentiment among closed-source frontier AI labs, which are losing business as users flock to cheaper, almost as capable models, though this is mere speculation. As of right now, open-weight models continue to closely follow the closed-source frontier, lagging behind by mere months.
Given the costs of running such models, the dangers of abliterated open-weight models being theoretically run by adversarial or malicious actors are certainly real, but perhaps not quite as attainable as Anthropic would want the general populace to think.
Sayem Ahmed is the Subscription Editor at Tom's Hardware. He covers a broad range of deep dives into hardware, both new and old, including the CPUs, GPUs, and everything else that uses a semiconductor. He has worked as a professional tech journalist since 2015 and has written for Gamespot, IGN, and Dexerto.

articles.title: Le kit Ring Alarm S avec caméra retrouve son prix du Prime Day à 119,99€
articles.text:
Le kit Ring Alarm S livré avec la caméra Indoor Cam de deuxième génération descend à 119,99 € sur Amazon, contre 239,97 € au plus bas des 30 derniers jours. L’offre est liée à un abonnement Ring Home Standard de 12 mois, qui pèse dans le calcul final.
Ring réunit dans un même carton son système d’alarme Ring Alarm, dans sa version Kit S, et sa petite caméra intérieure Indoor Cam de deuxième génération. Le lot compte six éléments : une base avec sirène, un clavier numérique, un capteur d’ouverture, un détecteur de mouvement, un amplificateur de portée et la caméra. Amazon le destine aux appartements et aux maisons d’une chambre.
Affiché à 119,99 €, le kit Ring Alarm S avec caméra intérieure coûte deux fois moins cher que son prix le plus bas des 30 derniers jours. Une condition change toutefois la donne : Amazon lie cette offre à un abonnement Ring Home Standard de 12 mois, vendu séparément.
Le kit Ring Alarm S + Indoor Cam (2e génération) est affiché à 119,99 € au lieu de 239,97 € sur Amazon, avec un abonnement Ring Home Standard de 12 mois requis.
Pourquoi choisir le kit Ring Alarm S + Indoor Cam ?
- Une pose sans installateur : Le capteur d’ouverture et le détecteur de mouvement se collent avec des bandes adhésives, seul le support du clavier se visse au mur. L’application Ring guide chaque élément pas à pas.
- Un réseau qui ne dépend pas du Wi-Fi : Les capteurs dialoguent avec la base en Z-Wave Plus, sur une portée d’environ 76 mètres. Un appartement moyen de 70 m² est largement couvert.
- Une caméra pour lever le doute : L’Indoor Cam filme en Full HD, de jour comme de nuit, et permet de parler à distance. Son cache physique masque l’objectif quand vous êtes chez vous.
Protéger un petit logement sans contrat de télésurveillance
Au quotidien, vous armez et désarmez l’alarme depuis le clavier ou l’application, et chaque porte ouverte ou mouvement détecté déclenche une notification. En cas d’intrusion, la base fait hurler sa sirène à 104 dB, un niveau que notre test du kit Ring Alarm 5 pièces jugeait en retrait des 120 dB courants chez la concurrence. Branchée en permanence, la base tient 24 heures sur batterie si le courant saute. Les capteurs fonctionnent sur piles lithium pendant environ trois ans, le clavier environ sept mois entre deux recharges.
La caméra complète le dispositif : posée sur un meuble, elle vous montre ce qui se passe quand l’alarme se déclenche, avant de prévenir un voisin ou la police. Ce kit s’adresse surtout aux occupants d’un petit logement qui veulent une protection autonome. Il convient moins à une maison à plusieurs accès, puisqu’un seul capteur d’ouverture est fourni et que les accessoires supplémentaires coûtent assez cher. Autre point à connaître : la caméra n’a pas de port microSD, l’enregistrement des vidéos passe donc par l’abonnement.
Autosurveillance ou télésurveillance, deux logiques différentes
Ring Alarm reste un système d’autosurveillance : c’est vous qui réagissez à l’alerte, et avec l’abonnement, vos trois contacts d’urgence sont appelés automatiquement si vous ne répondez pas. Les offres de télésurveillance comme Verisure, en tête de notre comparatif des meilleures alarmes maison, s’appuient au contraire sur un centre de surveillance actif 24 h/24. L’abonnement Ring ajoute aussi une connexion cellulaire de secours, qui garde l’alarme en ligne si votre box tombe en panne, et jusqu’à 180 jours d’historique vidéo pour la caméra.
✅ Les points forts
- Installation guidée, capteurs fixés par adhésif
- Réseau Z-Wave Plus indépendant du Wi-Fi
- Batterie de secours de 24 heures sur la base
- Caméra Full HD avec cache de confidentialité
❌ Les limites
- Abonnement Ring Home Standard de 12 mois imposé par l’offre
- Sirène de 104 dB, moins puissante que la moyenne
- Un seul capteur d’ouverture dans le kit
- Aucun stockage local pour les vidéos
Si l’abonnement de 12 mois entre dans votre budget, le kit Ring Alarm S + Indoor Cam reste proposé à 119,99 € chez Amazon, vendu et expédié par Amazon.
À 119,99 €, ce kit retrouve le prix auquel il s’affichait pendant le Prime Day de juin. Le vrai calcul inclut cependant l’abonnement : au tarif de départ de 8,30 € par mois annoncé par Amazon, il ajoute 99,60 € sur 12 mois, soit 219,59 € la première année. En échange, l’abonnement débloque les appels vers vos contacts d’urgence, le secours cellulaire et l’enregistrement des vidéos de la caméra.
Cette offre s’adresse donc à ceux qui comptaient de toute façon s’abonner pour tirer parti du système. Si vous refusez tout frais récurrent, mieux vaut regarder du côté des alarmes vendues sans abonnement. Même prudence si votre logement compte plusieurs portes et fenêtres à surveiller, car le budget accessoires grimpera vite. Pour un deux-pièces à protéger sans faire venir d’installateur, le compromis tient la route.
Pour profiter du Prime Day, n'oubliez pas de devenir membre Amazon Prime. Vous bénéficiez d'un essai gratuit de 30 jours, c'est donc le bon moment pour tester.

articles.title: On-demand GPU infrastructure startup GMI Cloud raises $263M to fuel global expansion - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
On-demand GPU infrastructure startup GMI Cloud raises $263M to fuel global expansion
Taiwan-based neocloud GMI Cloud Inc. wants to capitalize on what it says is an “unprecedented” demand for artificial intelligence computing power after raising a massive $663 million in funding from two sources.
The startup said today it has just closed on a $223 million Series B round of funding led by the robotics and AI-focused investment firm ARCHIV, with participation from Nvidia Corp., Redwood, DSC Investment, KT Corp., Kyobo Life, KB Investment and Trend Micro Inc. At the same time, it has secured a $440 million credit facility from ChinaTrust Commercial Bank, one of the largest financial institutions in Taiwan.
GMI Cloud is one of a host of specialized cloud infrastructure providers that have emerged in recent years to cater to the growing demand for access to graphics processing units and other resources needed to power AI workloads. The best-known of these neoclouds is CoreWeave Inc., which went public last year and has quickly become one of the darlings of Wall Street amid the AI boom. In Europe, there’s Nebius Group N.V., which rebranded from Yandex N.V. after selling off its Russian search engine firm Yandex.
Like its rivals, GMI Cloud offers an AI infrastructure-as-a-service platform that’s specially designed for resource-intensive AI training and inference workloads. It provides on-demand access to some of the most powerful GPUs available, including Nvidia’s H100 and H200 chips and its even newer Vera Rubin GPUs.
Its platform is powered by a proprietary Kubernetes-based infrastructure management system it calls the Cluster Engine, which automates resource allocation and instance provisioning so that developers can focus on their applications only. It’s a powerful advantage, because it means developers can spin up GPU clusters based on preconfigured environments in a matter of seconds. On traditional cloud infrastructure platforms, developers would have to manually configure these environments themselves.
GMI Cloud’s strong presence in the Asia-Pacific region is another key advantage, especially compared with CoreWeave and Nebius, whose data centers are mostly centered on the U.S. and Europe. The startup has dozens of data centers dotted around Taiwan, Thailand and Malaysia, which puts it in a strong position to cater to enterprises that want to run AI workloads locally in the region. However, it’s also building up a presence in the U.S., as well as a sovereign AI initiative in Japan that was launched earlier in the year.
Founder and Chief Executive Alex Yeh said demand for AI compute infrastructure has gone global. U.S.-based hyperscalers and AI startups are desperate to find more GPU capacity in Asia, where they have significant customer bases. In addition, there are thousands of APAC-based enterprises spearheading AI projects too, and all of these need a local source of compute.
“Our customers are scaling faster than ever and they need infrastructure that keeps pace,” Yeh said. “AI is driving a new renaissance and reliable compute is its foundation. Our goal is to build that foundation across continents, with an ecosystem of products on top of it.”
Being based in Taiwan gives GMI Cloud another major advantage, because the country also happens to be the world’s biggest factory for the AI server systems that populate data centers around the globe. Its close proximity to so many suppliers means the startup has an extremely secure supply chain and the ability to quickly procure all of the systems it needs to get its new data centers up and running, no matter where in the world they’re located.
“In AI infrastructure, a delivery date is a promise,” Yeh explained. “Customers plan launches, hiring and revenue around those dates. Our place in Taiwan’s supply chain is how we keep that promise, cluster after cluster globally.”
This reliability has already paid off for GMI Cloud in a big way. The startup said the amount of annual recurring revenue it has under contract is set to grow 10-fold at the end of the year from what it was in December 2025. As for ARR that’s already being realized, this is up five-fold in the last year, with its inference platform processing an average of more than 4 trillion tokens per week. It boasts a number of major enterprise customers, including Higgsfield Inc., OpenRouter, Nous Research Inc., Fireworks AI Inc. and Trend Micro.

articles.title: Dos juegos en Epic Games para PC que puedes reclamar gratis hoy sin necesidad de instalarlos
articles.text:
Epic Games Store mantiene durante las últimas horas de su oferta semanal a Astrea: Six-Sided Oracles y Mechabellum como juegos gratuitos para PC; quien los reclame antes de la renovación conservará ambos títulos de forma permanente, aunque no los instale de inmediato.
La promoción no consiste en pruebas temporales ni en fines de semana gratuitos. El canje vincula los juegos a la cuenta del usuario y permite descargarlos más adelante desde la biblioteca digital.
PUBLICIDAD
Para obtenerlos, hay que iniciar sesión en una cuenta de Epic Games, ingresar en la ficha de cada título y completar una compra con un precio de 0 dólares. Cuando termine la promoción semanal, ambos recuperarán su precio habitual y serán reemplazados por otros regalos.
De qué tratan los juegos gratuitos en Epic Games
Astrea: Six-Sided Oracles es un roguelike, un género basado en partidas con progresión y decisiones variables, que propone explorar los restos de una antigua civilización. El jugador dispone de seis Oráculos y debe administrar las tiradas de dados para construir una estrategia a partir de los resultados obtenidos.
Cada partida combina esa gestión con progresión individual y guardado en la nube. La mecánica exige decidir cómo aprovechar cada resultado para avanzar durante la exploración.
PUBLICIDAD
Mechabellum, en cambio, se centra en batallas de gran escala entre ejércitos mecanizados. La ubicación inicial de las unidades, las mejoras disponibles y la respuesta ante la composición del rival pueden modificar por completo el desarrollo de cada enfrentamiento.
La propuesta pone el foco en la planificación previa al combate y en la capacidad de adaptar la formación propia frente a las decisiones del oponente. Ambos juegos quedarán disponibles en la biblioteca de Epic Games Store una vez completado el canje dentro del plazo vigente.
Qué otros títulos están disponibles en las principales consolas de videojuegos
La última semana de septiembre y el inicio de octubre de 2026 reúne lanzamientos y expansiones para PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, PC a través de Steam, Nintendo Switch y Nintendo Switch 2.
PUBLICIDAD
El calendario incluye regresos de sagas conocidas, contenidos adicionales y títulos independientes de rol de acción, gestión, simulación y combates aéreos.
Entre las revisiones previstas figuran The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered y Dynasty Warriors 3: Complete Edition Remastered. Se suman estrenos como Minecraft Dungeons II, Songs of Glimmerwick y Nivalis Nights. La agenda contempla nuevos contenidos para Jurassic World Evolution 3 y Ghost of Yōtei.
Cómo acceder a juegos gratis en diferentes plataformas digitales
Steam ofrece cientos de juegos bajo el modelo gratuito y anuncia de manera periódica fines de semana sin costo para producciones de gran presupuesto. La PlayStation Store, por su parte, cuenta con un catálogo permanente de juegos multijugador masivos que permiten jugar en línea sin una suscripción activa.
PUBLICIDAD
Asimismo, las membresías de PlayStation Plus y Xbox Game Pass requieren un pago mensual, pero habilitan el acceso a cientos de videojuegos completos sin cargos adicionales. Microsoft Rewards permite acumular puntos mediante tareas y búsquedas diarias para canjearlos por meses de Game Pass.
Por qué no se debe acceder a versiones piratas sin costo de juegos
Diversos reportes de ciberseguridad confirman que los archivos modificados y los instaladores piratas funcionan con frecuencia como vectores de ataque para la distribución de malware, ransomware y troyanos.
Si se ejecutan estos programas, el usuario otorga permisos que permiten a actores maliciosos vulnerar la privacidad del sistema, sustraer credenciales financieras e infectar el dispositivo con código dañino.
PUBLICIDAD
Al carecer de parches oficiales y actualizaciones de seguridad, estos títulos suelen presentar fallos críticos de rendimiento, inestabilidad recurrente y un aislamiento total de las funciones multijugador, transformando un supuesto ahorro económico en una exposición a pérdidas de información sensible y daños irreversibles.
PUBLICIDAD

articles.title: SteelSeries brings ultra-wideband wireless to gaming mice, chasing lag-free tracking
articles.text:
Editor's take: SteelSeries keeps making gaming peripherals with hefty price tags. The Danish manufacturer has now launched redesigned versions of two popular rodents, bringing the ultra-wideband "revolution" to people looking to – in the company's own words – "keep beating kids" in online games.
After revealing its multi-platform luxury controller Aeon Pro, SteelSeries is now introducing yet another proposition for esports professionals or affluent multiplayer enthusiasts looking to get the most out of their frag sessions. The new Sensei Pro and Rival Pro gaming mice mark the 25th anniversary of the brand, providing high-performance wireless connectivity and other exclusive features.
The Sensei Pro and Rival Pro support ultra-wideband (UWB) technology, which should greatly improve signal stability during movement tracking. Ultra-wideband operates at much higher frequencies compared with traditional 2.4GHz mice, cutting through radio interference for a truly "lag-free" wireless gaming experience.
The new mice also feature an 8K polling rate, which should further reduce lag while improving stability and speed. The Sensei Pro is a symmetrical mouse built around 20-year-old design principles and should offer a comfortable "grip" for ambidextrous use. Meanwhile, the Rival Pro is an ergonomic rodent designed for a right-handed grip.
Additional features supported by both the Sensei Pro and Rival Pro include an "infinite" power system (IPS) with two separate batteries. Gamers can use one power source while the other is recharged inside the receiver. SteelSeries said that IPS technology can last for up to 120 hours (60 hours per battery) at a 1K polling rate, while battery life drops to 32 hours (16 hours per battery) at 8K.
Both the Sensei Pro and Rival Pro are available in black or white, with standard and "Mini" sizes offered for each color. All models come with a $180 price tag, with SteelSeries selling the mice directly through its online store. Meanwhile, third-party retailers should start selling the devices on October 13.
SteelSeries chose to introduce the "anniversary edition" of its Sensei Pro and Rival Pro mice with a cringey video clip about adult players who purchase premium pointing devices to beat kids in online shooters.
It's a strange flex no matter how you look at it, with SteelSeries ultimately declaring that if you still lose to kids with such a pricey, advanced mouse, you definitely "suck" at online gaming. Or maybe get a wired mouse for a fraction of the price and see how it goes.

articles.title: Novo Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K traz mais desempenho e melhora controle remoto • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Novo Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K traz mais desempenho e melhora controle remoto
Novo Fire TV Stick 4K já está em pré-venda no Brasil. Novidade chega com sistema operacional Vega OS e controle remoto com teclas mais táteis.
Depois de alguns vazamentos e rumores, a Amazon fez o anúncio oficial do novo Fire TV Stick 4K. A novidade promete ter inicialização mais rápida e traz um controle remoto redesenhado. O dispositivo foi anunciado para vários países, incluindo o Brasil. Por aqui, o preço sugerido é de R$ 579.
O novo Fire TV Stick 4K conta com um chip quad-core de 1,7 GHz (modelo ainda não revelado) e com 8 GB de capacidade de armazenamento. No quesito conectividade, há suporte para Wi-Fi 6 e Bluetooth 5.3, além de uma porta HDMI.
Assim como o Amazon Fire TV Stick HD, anunciado em maio, a versão 4K pode ser alimentada apenas pela porta USB da TV ou do monitor, dispensando a sua conexão a uma tomada, ao contrário dos modelos anteriores.
Em termos de desempenho, a Amazon afirma que o Fire TV Stick 4K é até 40% mais rápido do que o modelo equivalente de uma marca rival (presumo que a empresa esteja falando da Roku) e, com relação à geração anterior, é 35% mais ágil na abertura de aplicativos, além de ter 20% mais desempenho na reprodução de conteúdo.
Como o próprio nome deixa claro, o principal atributo do dispositivo é a sua capacidade de reproduzir vídeos em 4K, desde que a TV ou monitor seja compatível com essa resolução, é claro. Também há suporte para padrões como HDR10, HDR10+, HLG, H.265, H.264, VP9 e AV1.
Já o sistema operacional é o Vega OS, da própria Amazon. Ao contrário do antecessor Fire OS, esse sistema não é baseado no Android, mas suporta aplicativos de diversas plataformas de streaming, como Netflix, YouTube, Globoplay, Apple TV e, obviamente, Amazon Prime Video. Também há suporte para a Alexa+, como não poderia deixar de ser.
O Fire TV Stick 4K também renova o controle remoto. O acessório agora tem uma borda reta na parte superior, enquanto a inferior é bastante curvada. Porém, a característica mais notável, segundo a Amazon, está no fato de o controle ter sido projetado para ter botões mais táteis, de modo que o usuário consiga usá-los sem olhar para o dispositivo.
A tecla de início, por ser a mais pressionada, ganhou uma superfície metálica que facilita a sua localização via toque. Também há um botão “estrela” que pode ser configurado pelo usuário para abrir seu aplicativo favorito, embora teclas que levem a plataformas específicas (como Netflix e Prime Video) continuem por lá.
No Brasil, o novo Fire TV Stick 4K tem preço oficial de R$ 579 (sem considerar descontos ou promoções). O dispositivo já está em pré-venda no site da Amazon.
As entregas estão previstas para começar em 2 de novembro de 2026, embora possam ser efetuadas antes para determinadas localidades.

articles.title: Infineon Advances USB 20 Gbps Ecosystem with PCIe Reference Design for 5-Meter Cabling and 36W Power Delivery
articles.text:
Wednesday, September 30th 2026
	
	
	
	
Infineon Advances USB 20 Gbps Ecosystem with PCIe Reference Design for 5-Meter Cabling and 36W Power Delivery
Infineon Technologies AG (FSE: IFX / OTCQX: IFNNY), a global leader in USB semiconductor solutions, today announced a new PCI Express Gen 4 x4 add-on card reference design that addresses key barriers to USB 20 Gbps (USB 3.2 Gen 2×2) adoption. Debuting at VISION Stuttgart 2026, the industry-first standalone reference design integrates ASMedia's ASM4242 USB4 host controller with Infineon's EZ-PD CCG7 USB Power Delivery (PD) controller to support robust, high-performance connectivity for machine vision systems.
A primary focus of this release is Infineon's continued effort to expand and mature the USB 20 Gbps ecosystem. While the standard offers double the bandwidth of previous generations, widespread industrial adoption has been limited by signal integrity challenges over longer distances and complex power requirements. This new reference design directly addresses these hurdles by enabling reliable data transmission over 5-meter passive USB cables, which is important for industrial environments where cameras are often mounted far from the host PC. By demonstrating USB 20 Gbps operation over passive cabling at this length, Infineon helps reduce an integration challenge for system designers.The reference design features two USB-C ports, each supporting USB 20 Gbps data transfer and USB Power Delivery up to 36 W (supporting 5 V / 3 A and 12 V / 3 A profiles). This combination allows for the deployment of AI-based camera systems without the need for separate power supplies, simplifying cabling and improving reliability in factory and lab settings. Targeting machine vision manufacturers, industrial PC suppliers, and system integrators, this solution provides a ready-to-use platform that accelerates time-to-market for next-generation imaging applications.
Ganesh Subramaniam, Senior Vice President of Wired Connectivity Solutions at Infineon"Infineon is committed to driving the USB 20 Gbps ecosystem forward by solving the real-world challenges that have slowed its adoption in industrial markets. One of the key hurdles for machine vision applications has been maintaining signal integrity over long passive cables while delivering sufficient power to advanced sensors. This PCIe Gen 4 x4 reference design demonstrates that USB 20 Gbps is not just a high-speed data standard, but a practical, robust solution for industrial connectivity. By supporting 5-meter passive cabling and 36 W of power per port, we are empowering camera OEMs and system integrators to deploy AI-driven vision systems with confidence, knowing that the underlying connectivity infrastructure is reliable and easy to implement."

articles.title: OpenAI lance Dots, mais Elon Musk semble avoir préparé le troll ultime
articles.text:
OpenAI vient de présenter Dots, son nouvel agent d’IA. Mais l’adresse dot.com renvoie vers Grok, le chatbot d’Elon Musk. Sur X, certains y voient un troll préparé à l’avance.
Le 29 septembre 2026, la présentation de Dots a donné une seconde vie à un nom de domaine qui n’a rien d’officiel pour OpenAI. C’est le compte @birdabo qui a repéré cette redirection sur X, de quoi alimenter une hypothèse : Elon Musk aurait connu le nom du produit à l’avance et préparé ce pied de nez à OpenAI.
Dots débarque, Musk trolle
Dots est présenté comme un agent d’IA toujours actif, doté d’un avatar coloré aux formes arrondies. L’adresse dot.com, sans le « s », appartient pourtant à xAI, l’entreprise d’IA fondée par Elon Musk. Elle renvoie directement vers la page de téléchargement de Grok Bot, comme le rapporte TechCrunch.
Selon les données Whois citées par TechCrunch, le domaine a été transféré en juillet, soit environ deux mois avant l’annonce de Dots. On ignore en revanche depuis quand il renvoie vers Grok.
Autre nuance : le produit s’appelle Dots, au pluriel. L’adresse dots.com appartient, elle, à une entreprise depuis longtemps inactive.
Un troll de Musk ou une simple coïncidence ?
Une autre explication est possible : xAI aurait acheté dot.com pour récupérer les visites d’internautes qui taperaient cette adresse au lieu de bot.com. L’achat n’aurait alors aucun rapport avec Dots. L’entreprise ne possède toutefois pas bot.com.
La rivalité donne évidemment à cette coïncidence une résonance particulière. Musk a cofondé OpenAI avant de lancer Grok face à ChatGPT. Et si le nom xAI circule encore, la société n’existe plus comme entité indépendante depuis la réorganisation annoncée en mai : ses activités IA relèvent désormais de SpaceXAI, tandis que Grok continue d’exister.
TechCrunch a interrogé xAI, mais n’a pas obtenu de réponse. Rien ne confirme donc que cette redirection ait été préparée pour piéger OpenAI. Coïncidence ou pas, elle fait parler de Grok en plein lancement de Dots. GG Elon ?

articles.title: 7 Books that help you make smarter decisions in life
articles.text:
7 Books that help you make smarter decisions in life
Discover seven insightful books that can help you make smarter decisions & navigate life's challenges with greater confidence.
Every day, we make decisions that shape our lives.
Some are small and forgettable, while others influence our careers, relationships, finances, and personal growth. Yet making good decisions is rarely easy. Emotions, biases, uncertainty, and outside pressures often cloud our judgment, causing us to act impulsively or overlook important information.
Fortunately, some of the world's most insightful thinkers have explored how people make choices and how those choices can improve.
The books on this list offer practical lessons on critical thinking, psychology, habits, and decision-making. Whether you're facing a major life change or simply want to think more clearly, these books can help you make smarter decisions.
1. Thinking, Fast and Slow by Daniel Kahneman
Nobel Prize-winning psychologist Daniel Kahneman explains the two systems that drive human thinking. One is fast, intuitive, and emotional, while the other is slow, analytical, and deliberate.
The book reveals common cognitive biases that influence decisions without us realising it.
By understanding these mental shortcuts, readers can become more aware of errors in judgment and make more thoughtful choices.
2. Decisive by Chip Heath and Dan Heath
Written specifically about decision-making, Decisive offers a practical framework for making better choices.
The Heath brothers explain why people often fall into predictable decision traps and provide strategies for avoiding them. From widening options to testing assumptions, the book offers actionable tools that can be applied in everyday life.
3. The Psychology of Money by Morgan Housel
Although focused on money, this book contains lessons that extend far beyond finance.
Morgan Housel explores how emotions, experiences, and personal biases influence decision-making. His stories demonstrate that success often depends less on intelligence and more on behaviour, patience, and long-term thinking.
4. The Almanack of Naval Ravikant by Eric Jorgenson
This collection of ideas from entrepreneur and investor Naval Ravikant covers wealth, happiness, learning, and decision-making.
Naval emphasises independent thinking, leverage, and long-term perspectives. His reflections encourage readers to focus on what truly matters and avoid making decisions based solely on social expectations or short-term rewards.
5. The Art of Thinking Clearly by Rolf Dobelli
Rolf Dobelli examines dozens of cognitive biases that influence everyday decisions.
Through short, engaging chapters, the book explains why people often misjudge risks, follow the crowd, or become overconfident in their beliefs. Understanding these biases can help readers make more rational and informed choices.
6. Four Thousand Weeks by Oliver Burkeman
Many decisions become difficult because people feel pressured to do everything at once. Oliver Burkeman offers a refreshing perspective by reminding readers that time is limited.
The book encourages prioritising what matters most rather than constantly chasing productivity. It provides valuable insights into making decisions that align with personal values and long-term goals.
7. How We Change by Katy Milkman
Behavioural scientist Katy Milkman explores why people struggle to make decisions that support their goals and what can be done about it.
Drawing from psychology and real-world examples, she explains how habits are formed, why motivation fluctuates, and how small adjustments can lead to lasting change. The book is particularly useful for anyone trying to make better decisions consistently.
Final thoughts
Smart decisions are rarely the result of luck. They come from understanding how we think, recognising our biases, considering long-term consequences, and learning from experience.
The books on this list approach decision-making from different angles, but they all share a common goal: helping readers think more clearly and choose more wisely.
Whether you're making decisions about your career, finances, relationships, or personal growth, these books offer valuable insights that can help you navigate life with greater confidence and clarity.

articles.title: Plus petit, portée triplée : tout ce qui change avec le nouveau Samsung SmartTag 3
articles.text:
Samsung dévoile sa troisième génération de balise GPS, les SmartTags 3, annoncés en même temps que la nouvelle Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra (que nous avons testée). Ceux-ci sont 35 % plus petits et ils ont également plus légers dans les mêmes proportions. Samsung a revu une nouvelle fois le design et s’éloigne du choix opéré pour les SmartTags 2 d’un modèle plus volumineux intégrant un crochet. Sauf que, d’après les études utilisateurs de Samsung, seuls 30 % des acheteurs souhaitaient attacher le tag à leur clé. Ce nouveau format apparait donc plus polyvalent.
Malgré la même pile utilisée, ils tiennent désormais jusqu’à 790 jours en mode économie d’énergie. Il est aussi étanche et possède un bouton pour effectuer des raccourcis de domotique ou faire sonner son smartphone.
Des nouveautés logicielles et une compatibilité iOS
Pour retrouver son SmarTag et les objets qui y sont attachés, Samsung revendique près de 800 millions d’appareils Samsung Find. Petite nouveauté logicielle intéressante pour en profiter, si vous possédez un smartphone compatible avec l’ultra wide band, désormais vous pourrez activer le système de chaud-froid très efficace pour retrouver votre appareil à partir de 60 m de distance, contre 20 m avant.
Il est également possible de créer un périmètre dans lequel le SmartTag est censé rester. Utile pour les animaux, par exemple, puisqu’on peut attacher l’accessoire à un collier. Il est aussi possible de partager la localisation avec des membres de sa famille ou encore d’accéder à un historique des localisations.
Mais l’annonce la plus tonitruante est sans aucun doute la compatibilité avec les appareils iOS. Samsung a pris grand soin de porter son app de domotique SmartThings dans l’environnement Apple, autant qu’elle serve à ses propres appareils pour concurrencer Apple dans son propre écosystème.
Prix et disponibilités du SmartTag 3
Les SmartTags 3 seront disponibles d’ci la fin d’année 2026 ou le début d’année 2027. On en connaît déjà le prix : 39,99 euros pour un seul tag et 119,99 euros pour le pack de quatre.

articles.title: "On est allés trop loin” : Mercedes reconnaît que ses voitures ont perdu trop de boutons et veut faire marche arrière
articles.text:
"On est allés trop loin” : Mercedes reconnaît que ses voitures ont perdu trop de boutons et veut faire marche arrière
Les boutons reprennent du service
C'est donc officiel : Ola Källenius, PDG de Mercedes-Benz, admet que la suppression des boutons physiques au profit des dalles tactiles géantes était une erreur. Le constructeur promet d'en réintroduire dans ses prochains modèles.
Régler la climatisation à 22 °C, monter le volume d'un cran, basculer les essuie-glaces en intermittent : des gestes autrefois mécaniques, accomplis sans quitter la route des yeux. Mais depuis quelques années, il faut pour cela naviguer dans des sous-menus enfouis derrière un écran. Dans une interview accordée au magazine britannique Autocar, paru le 31 juillet 2026, le PDG de Mercedes-Benz a reconnu publiquement que cette course au tout-numérique avait dépassé les bornes.
	
Parfois, on se laisse emporter et l’on développe de la technologie pour la technologie, en oubliant quelque peu le client. Dans certains domaines, on est allés trop loin. Désormais, vous nous verrez réintroduire les boutons les plus pertinents.
Mercedes fait marche arrière : quels boutons reviennent dans ses voitures ?
Le virage est déjà amorcé, puisque sur la nouvelle CLA, Mercedes a remplacé le curseur capacitif du volant par une vraie molette de volume, physique et crantée. Le GLC With EQ Technology et le CLA Shooting Brake héritent du même volant repensé, avec des commandes tangibles en lieu et place des surfaces tactiles. Källenius promet que d'autres contrôles "sensés" suivront, sans pour autant renoncer à l'Hyperscreen MBUX, cette dalle tri-écran de 142 cm qui tapisse le tableau de bord d'un montant A à l'autre. Les grands affichages restent. Ce sont les commandes critiques qui retrouvent une existence physique.
Volkswagen a déjà réintroduit des boutons physiques sur le volant de la Golf Mk8.5 après les critiques visant ses commandes tactiles. Hyundai a remis des boutons et molettes dans le Tucson restylé, tandis que Ferrari a annoncé le retour de commandes physiques sur ses futurs modèles après les plaintes de ses clients. Porsche adopte une approche hybride, en conservant des commandes tactiles tout en réintroduisant certains contrôles physiques.
Pourquoi l'Europe et la Chine imposent le retour des boutons en voiture
La pression réglementaire accélère le mouvement car depuis janvier 2026, Euro NCAP pénalise les voitures dépourvues de commandes physiques pour les fonctions critiques : clignotants, feux de détresse, essuie-glaces, klaxon, appel d'urgence. Sans ces contrôles, impossible de décrocher les cinq étoiles. Or, selon Euro NCAP, environ 90 % des acheteurs européens consultent cette note avant de signer un bon de commande. La Chine prépare un cadre similaire via le ministère de l'Industrie (MIIT), applicable à tous les véhicules neufs produits après juillet 2027.
	
Les nouvelles évaluations de l’interface homme-machine examineront notamment la disposition, la clarté et la facilité d’utilisation des commandes essentielles, y compris la présence de boutons physiques pour les fonctions couramment utilisées, dont les retours des consommateurs montrent qu’ils peuvent réduire la distraction.
La Tesla Model S, lancée en 2012, a popularisé l’idée d’un habitacle piloté par un grand écran central. Depuis, de nombreux constructeurs ont suivi cette voie, parfois jusqu’à enfouir des fonctions essentielles dans des menus numériques. Mercedes redécouvre aujourd’hui une règle très simple : certaines commandes doivent rester accessibles immédiatement, sans détourner le regard de la route.

articles.title: En Asturias hay más de 300 profesores de asturiano y tienen un problema: llevan años esperando a una oposición que no existe
articles.text:
Antes de preguntarnos si se habla mucho o poco asturiano, empecemos por una historia: una noche de marzo, un grupo de profesores de asturiano durmió en el gimnasio de un colegio de Gijón. Los acompañaban sindicalistas de CCOO y SUATEA. Salieron a primera hora del viernes con la misma situación con la que entraron: sin plaza fija. Algunos encadenaban contratos desde hacía 40 años. No perdieron ninguna oposición, porque ni siquiera había. La especialidad que los ampara no existe.
La iniciativa
La asignatura arrancó en 1984 en media docena de escuelas, como optativa. Desde la ley de 1998 todos los centros deben ofrecerla, pero cada alumno decide si la cursa. Lo que nunca tuvo es especialidad propia. Sus docentes la reclaman desde hace 42 años. Mientras tanto, los interinos cubren con contratos temporales una necesidad permanente. Lo admite hasta el texto de la reforma.
En el último curso hubo 318 docentes: 295 de asturiano y 23 de eonaviego, la variedad del occidente que la ley de 1998 llama gallego-asturiano. Otro recuento de marzo daba 332. Como fuera, la matrícula subió: más de 30.000 alumnos, un 34% más que el curso anterior, empujada en parte por Infantil.
La frase
El real decreto de Secundaria solo prevé especialidad propia para las lenguas de comunidades con lengua cooficial. Hay que tocar además el de Maestros y el de las Escuelas Oficiales de Idiomas. La reforma abre la lista a las lenguas no oficiales con protección legal. El Ministerio se apoya en el artículo 3.3 de la Constitución, que protege la riqueza de las modalidades lingüísticas, y en la Carta Europea de las Lenguas Regionales o Minoritarias. España la ratificó en 2001 e incluyó en su declaración a las lenguas que los estatutos protegen.
La cuestión es que un real decreto no pasa por las Cortes: todavía faltan el informe del Consejo de Estado y la aprobación del Consejo de Ministros. Después llegará el turno del Principado: un único decreto para asturiano y eonaviego y, a partir de ahí, las convocatorias.
El pulso de un año
Durante meses, el Ministerio respondió que no: el asturiano no es lengua oficial. Solo el catalán, el euskera, el gallego y el valenciano podían ser especialidad. En julio de 2025, tras la huelga docente de mayo y junio, el Principado firmó el pacto Asturias Educa y se comprometió a pedir el cambio. En diciembre, los profesores fueron al Defensor del Pueblo.
En febrero, el parlamento asturiano aprobó reclamarlo y el PP acusó a Barbón de vender humo. A finales de marzo, decenas de docentes se encadenaron ante el Ministerio, en Madrid. En mayo hubo otro encierro, esta vez en la Consejería. El 9 de julio, con Milagros Tolón ya en el cargo, llegó el acuerdo. La ministra lo presentó como un gesto de respeto a la diversidad lingüística del país.
Qué cambia
Nada para el alumno: la asignatura sigue siendo voluntaria. Para el profesor cambia casi todo. Podrá presentarse a oposiciones para una plaza en propiedad. Tendrá además un marco propio de selección, provisión y movilidad. Barbón lo plantea como un problema laboral: la interinidad prolongada contraviene, dice, el Estatuto Básico del Empleado Público. El decreto lo formula en términos de gestión: acceder a las plazas por el cauce ordinario, cubrir vacantes y sustituciones, planificar las plantillas.
Y la especialidad no oficializa nada: sirve justo para las lenguas que no lo son. Pero ahí está la pelea. El artículo 4 del Estatuto protege el asturiano y promete promover su enseñanza, con aprendizaje voluntario. Oficializarlo exige reformar el Estatuto con 27 de los 45 votos de la Junta General. En junio de 2025, la propuesta sumó 22 votos, con 21 en contra. El 23 de septiembre, Barbón propuso que la reforma fuera una de las primeras leyes de la próxima legislatura.
Dos cuentas
Los docentes ya existen y ya cobran, así que lo que ha cambiado es su contrato. El gasto visible está en otro sitio. El Principado presupuestó 5 millones para llevar la lengua a Infantil, con un centenar de docentes, y aprobó una estrategia de 245 medidas hasta 2030. Cultura destina 415.320 euros a los servicios de normalización de 36 concejos, que abarcan el 60% de la población. El presupuesto autonómico de 2026 es de 6.993 millones.
Vox hace una cuenta distinta. Estima que el Principado gasta al menos 55 millones de euros en promover la lengua y que la oficialidad costaría 250 millones al año. Acusa al Gobierno de colar esa oficialidad por vía indirecta. En 2024, la Academia de la Llingua, defensora de esa oficialidad, calculó 25 millones anuales, 14 más que la inversión de entonces en normalización. Gobierno y sindicatos hablan de otra cosa: derechos laborales de un colectivo que sostiene una enseñanza protegida por el Estatuto.
Más allá de Asturias
La norma habla de lenguas no oficiales con protección legal. La ministra citó también otras lenguas protegidas por ley, y crear la especialidad le tocará a cada comunidad que así lo quiera. El leonés encaja: el Estatuto de Castilla y León le promete protección específica. En 2022, la consejera de Educación juzgó imposible enseñarlo: faltaban una gramática oficial y profesorado titulado.
En 2023, el Procurador del Común pidió a la Junta financiar su enseñanza, con una recomendación del Consejo de Europa de respaldo. Desde 2024, la Universidad de León ofreció ‘El leonés en el aula’, un curso de diez euros pensado para entre 10 y 40 docentes. La Junta dota con 70.000 euros al año a la Cátedra de Estudios Leoneses. En diciembre de 2024, PP y Vox tumbaron una moción del PSOE para ofertar la asignatura.
¿Y el aragonés?
Es la única lengua exclusiva de Aragón. Y no la hablan muchos. El último recuento, basado en un viejo censo de 2011, contó 25.556 personas que dicen saber hablarlo, un 1,9% de los aragoneses. Buena parte son hablantes pasivos que lo usan solo en situaciones excepcionales. Se conserva sobre todo en el norte de Aragón, en el área que va de Ansó a Benás, y la UNESCO lo considera una lengua en peligro. El dato tiene ya quince años: el Consejo de Europa pidió a España precisar cuántos lo hablan y el Gobierno de Aragón impulsó en 2023 un estudio sociolingüístico.
La enseñanza del aragonés arrancó con cuatro maestros en Jaca, Biescas, L'Aínsa y Benasque. Llegó a una veintena de docentes y cerca de 1.500 alumnos en unas 60 escuelas. Hoy quedan unos 20 profesores, interinos desde el curso 1997-1998 y sin opción de consolidar plaza. La Universidad de Zaragoza ofrece en Huesca, desde 2020-2021, un grado de Magisterio con mención en Lengua Aragonesa. La reforma estatal les abre la puerta a una plaza fija, pero no crea ninguna: primero hay que modificar tres decretos y después decide Aragón.
La enseñanza arrancó con cuatro maestros en Jaca, Biescas, L'Aínsa y Benasque. Llegó a una veintena de docentes y cerca de 1.500 alumnos en unas 60 escuelas. Hoy son unos 20 profesores, interinos desde el curso 1997-1998 y sin opción de consolidar plaza. La Universidad de Zaragoza ofrece desde 2020-2021 una mención en lengua aragonesa en los grados de Infantil y Primaria. La reforma estatal les abre la puerta a una plaza fija, pero no crea ninguna: primero hay que modificar tres decretos y después decide Aragón. Aragón ya movió ficha en 2022, cuando sometió a información pública una orden propia para establecer la especialidad.
El aragonés tiene amparo en el Estatuto y en una ley de 2013, pero, según un estudio de 2021, en los colegios e institutos oscenses su presencia depende de la voluntad de cada centro. Hoy gobiernan PP y Vox, y el pacto que firmaron en 2023 contemplaba revisar la ley de lenguas. En 2024, Vox propuso quitar al aragonés y al catalán la condición de lenguas propias en la ley de patrimonio cultural, y el PP votó en contra. Sobre la especialidad, el Ejecutivo aragonés no se pronunció públicamente, que sepamos. Sumar registró en el Congreso una proposición para reconocerla.
Tic-tac. La consulta pública previa cerró el curso pasado, el 31 de julio. Contado desde el anuncio, el plazo de cinco o seis meses cae entre diciembre y enero de 2027. Después, el Principado necesita su decreto. Hasta entonces, más de 300 interinos siguen esperando.

articles.title: Smart radio startup Relay raises $36M to help businesses capture vital intelligence from frontline workers - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Smart radio startup Relay raises $36M to help businesses capture vital intelligence from frontline workers
The business communications startup Relay Inc. says it’s trying to capture “frontline intelligence” for enterprises after raising $36 million in funding, bringing its total amount raised so far to more than $90 million.
Today’s round was led by the industrial manufacturing giant International Paper Co. and saw participation from the wealth management firm Cerity Partners Ventures and existing backer G2 Ventures.
Relay is the developer of a cloud-hosted smart radio communications system that now wants to bring the artificial intelligence revolution to workforces who don’t sit at desks in front of a computer all day. Its technology is designed for frontline workers who spend the bulk of their shifts on their feet, whether that’s operating production lines in factories, cleaning hotel rooms, caring for patients, responding to emergencies, pushing trolleys around a supermarket or something else.
For many of these kinds of workers, Relay’s smart radio system is the primary interface for organizing their daily work. They’ll use its radios to report back to their supervisor, provide critical updates, report problems and so on.
Relay says that much of the most valuable operational knowledge at these kinds of businesses is communicated over the radio waves – and most of it stays there. Frontline workers are usually too busy to enter this data into a computer, and that means almost half of it is never recorded by anyone. It simply disappears after it has been spoken.
Evaporating signals
Co-founder and Chief Executive Chris Chuang calls this problem “signal evaporation,” and says it can have a real impact on a businesses’s finances, leading to missed handoffs, rework and expensive operational delays. “Signal evaporation occurs because of the way human cognition works,” he explained. “With traditional systems of record, workers are asked to record the details of what happened, sometimes hours after they’re removed from the specific task or incident they’re reporting. The information is subject to recall and interpretation, and can therefore be incomplete or inaccurate, if it’s recorded at all.”
That’s why Chuang believes businesses can gain a significant competitive advantage by using AI to capture what their frontline workers say in real time, so they don’t have to record them after the fact, and he intends to help them do just that. Relay has developed a voice AI system that integrates with its smart radio platform to capture worker’s conversations as they use their handheld radios to communicate, transforming those words into structured and queryable data that can feed into operational workflows and generate useful insights that improve business efficiency. It understands domain-specific jargon, and that helps to ensure critical safety issues and maintenance requests never get lost in the noise of day to day work.
Chuang offered the example of someone working in a warehouse who reports over the radio that “the palletizer has broken down three times this week.” Many AI tools might struggle to understand the word “palletizer” and confuse it for a word like “appetizer,” but not Relay. Because it’s trained on the relevant jargon, it will understand there is a recurring glitch with the machine that stacks goods onto pallets ready for shipping, and it will automatically create a work order ticket to get it fixed.
“As the problem is fixed, the technician can speak into Relay the details of what they’ve found and the steps they’re taking to address it,” Chuang explained. “This is then structured and becomes part of the documented record. As a result, root cause analysis is streamlined and unplanned downtime is reduced, closing the gap between what’s spoken on the line and stored in a traditional CMMS.”
Relay’s AI system can also translate conversations for multilingual teams. The company has developed a TeamTranslate capability, which provides real-time voice translation in more than 30 languages to help diverse teams get around any language barriers. Workers speak in their native language, and TeamTranslate will automatically relay what they’re saying in the receiver’s own language to enable seamless over-the-radio communication.
A goldmine of data
“A lot of our customers never realized how much of their business operations were never formally recorded,” Chuang said. “We’ve seen official logs at major manufacturers capture only about one in four equipment stoppages. Everything else stays in the live discussions over radio and in people’s memories. In a loud, fast-moving manufacturing plant, much of it gets lost before someone is able to record it.”
In another example, workers at a food processing facility would often use their Relay radios to discuss a broken water pump that was functioning poorly, yet despite all of the grumbling and disruption it caused, no one got around to creating a record, and so no maintenance order was filed in the computerized maintenance management system, Chuang related.
“Eventually, the maintenance manager spotted this while looking through the Relay transcripts and realized the pump needed to be replaced,” he recalled. “But his directors weren’t convinced that the issue was real, and didn’t want to spend $75,000 on a replacement water pump. Relay provided the evidence needed that no other system of record held, and the issue was dealt with as planned downtime rather than an unplanned catastrophe.”
International Paper decided to lead today’s round after seeing the benefits of Relay’s technology with its own eyes. According to Keith Townsent, group vice president of Packaging Solutions North America at International Paper, reliable communication is invaluable when it comes to the complex industrial operations his company performs.
“Relay has proven it can deliver clear, dependable communications in extremely loud and challenging industrial environments,” he said. “It goes beyond communications to improve shift transitions, strengthen operating processes, accelerate responses to safety and maintenance alerts and connect frontline insights into operational systems.”
Chuang said the backing of one of its major customers is the strongest validation of its technology that it could hope for. “What makes this round special isn’t the capital being raised,” he said. “It’s the alignment with leaders from the industries we serve on how Relay can help them digitally transform physical operations. It’s a powerful endorsement when customers aren’t just buying your system but also betting on the company behind it.”
The startup plans to use the money to accelerate the development of its AI capabilities and worker safety systems while deepening its integrations with other enterprise platforms. It’s also looking at developing new kinds of hardware for frontline worker communications as it eyes expansion across the industrial and hospitality sectors.

articles.title: Trump anuncia IA própria do governo dos Estados Unidos • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Trump anuncia IA própria do governo dos Estados Unidos
America.gov foi reformulado e agora usa chatbot de IA para acessar serviços públicos. Projeto foi liderado pelo cofudandor do Airbnb.
O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, anunciou uma nova ferramenta de inteligência artificial do governo. A ferramenta integra o site reformulado America.gov e, segundo Trump, deve simplificar o acesso a informações e serviços públicos. A ordem assinada nesta terça-feira (29/09) também prevê que todas as agências governamentais integrem seus conteúdos públicos à IA.
A assinatura do documento aconteceu horas antes do anúncio oficial, durante uma reunião entre o presidente e líderes de IA do mercado. O encontro foi promovido para discutir os riscos da tecnologia, tendo em vista as preocupações recentes sobre o ritmo do desenvolvimento em IA.
O site reformulado do governo já está disponível em formato de chatbot. Por lá, é possível fazer perguntas como em qualquer outra ferramenta do tipo, mas as respostas partem de um banco de dados próprio do governo dos EUA. Em algumas respostas, a IA chegou a contradizer declarações do presidente Trump, como destaca a Forbes.
Durante o anúncio da inteligência artificial, o presidente Trump destacou alguns tipos de uso com a nova plataforma. Entre os exemplos estão dar entrada em aplicações de passaporte, selecionar planos de saúde e facilitar o acesso de veteranos aos benefícios oferecidos pelo governo.
O site foi desenvolvido pelo cofundador do Airbnb, atualmente chefe de design do governo, Joe Gebbia. Segundo ele, o objetivo é que as pessoas pesquisem exatamente o que precisam e “nunca mais voltem para o labirinto”. O acesso, portanto, será unificado pela plataforma.
Além de revelar a nova plataforma do governo, Trump aproveitou a situação para indicar que busca caminhar na outra direção das últimas declarações de desenvolvedores de IA. Ao invés de diminuir o ritmo da tecnologia, o presidente dos EUA quer acelerar seu desenvolvimento.
Trump afirmou que pretende mudar a nomenclatura usada para se referir à tecnologia. A ideia é chamar as IAs de “superinteligências”, termo associado à Inteligência Artificial Geral (AGI) e frequentemente usado nas discussões sobre o futuro da inteligência artificial.
Nesse novo estágio, em termos técnicos, a IA seria capaz de agir por conta própria e até mesmo corrigir seus erros – o chamado autoaperfeiçoamento recursivo. Segundo o presidente dos EUA, o movimento será maior que a Revolução Industrial, e “quem ‘ganhar’ a superinteligência, vence”.

articles.title: Criptomonedas: cuál es el valor de Bitcoin este miércoles
articles.text:
El bitcoin, la primera moneda virtual lanzada al mercado, fue creado por Satoshi Nakamoto (pseudónimo) en 2008 tras la crisis financiera que afectó al mundo; esta divisa digital tenía como base un ideal libertario y buscaba poner en jaque a las instituciones monetarias y financieras tradicionales.
Conocido en el mundo de los mercados bajo las siglas BTC, el bitcoin utiliza la criptografía para garantizar que su gestión sea descentralizada, es decir, que no pueda ser regulado por ninguna institución u organismo bancario, lo que a su vez hace que las criptomonedas sean volátiles.
PUBLICIDAD
Pese al avance y alcance que ha tenido el Bitcoin y otros activos digitales de gran talla como Ethereum, organismos como el Banco Mundial, el Fondo Monetario Internacional (FMI) y el Banco Interamericano de Desarrollo (BID) aún se muestran dudosos sobre los "pros" de este tipo de criptomonedas.
La victoria electoral de Donald Trump significó un movimiento positivo para las principales criptomonedas del mercado. A finales de 2024, bitcoin registró un nuevo máximo histórico que logró superar los 107.000 dólares por unidad, después de que el presidente estadounidense reiteró su idea de crear una reserva estratégica de la criptodivisa en Estados Unidos.
PUBLICIDAD
Las divisas digitales serán un foco de atención durante este año, las iniciativas del presidente de Estados Unidos y el desarrollo de nuevos modelos de inteligencia artificial fungirán un papel importante en la cotización de estos activos. Después del lanzamiento del nuevo modelo de IA chino DeepSeek, BTC y otras criptos cayeron en la mayoría de los mercados de valores.
Cotización de la criptomoneda Bitcoin
La cotización de bitcoin para este día a las 14:00 horas (UTC) es de 84552.95 dólares, lo que significa que la criptomoneda sufrió un cambio de 0.21% en las últimas 24 horas.
Por otro lado, registró un cambio de 0.0% con respecto a su valor hace una hora. En cuanto a su popularidad, se ubica en la posición #1.
PUBLICIDAD
Bitcoin alcanza un nuevo récord y lidera el auge en el mercado de las criptomonedas
En marzo del año pasado el bitcoin ha logrado un nuevo máximo histórico, superando los valores anteriores y reafirmándose como la criptomoneda más importante en el mercado, acercándose a los 73 mil dólares. Este récord se obtuvo en medio de un flujo sin precedentes de inversiones hacia las criptomonedas, un acontecimiento notable para el sector financiero digital.
El aumento en el valor de bitcoin ocurre en un contexto donde hay un entrante masivo de capital hacia las criptomonedas, lo que indica un creciente interés y confianza de los inversores en estos activos. La subida del precio beneficia no solo a bitcoin sino que también tiene un impacto positivo en el mercado de las criptomonedas en general, favoreciendo una mayor estabilidad y visibilidad, de acuerdo a un análisis de Bloomberg.
PUBLICIDAD
Expertos financiaron este aumento a diferentes factores, como la adopción institucional de las criptomonedas, la búsqueda de alternativas de inversión debido a la incertidumbre económica mundial y la innovación continua en la tecnología blockchain que respalda a bitcoin y otras divisas digitales. Esta combinación de factores ha creado un entorno propicio para el crecimiento continuo en el valor de Bitcoin.
Cómo adquirir criptomonedas
Para comprarlas e intercambiarlas se utilizan portales especializados. Su valor varía en función de la oferta, de la demanda y del compromiso de los usuarios, por lo que puede cambiar más rápido que el dinero tradicional, pero mientras más gente esté interesada y quiera comprar determinada divisa, mayor será su valor.
PUBLICIDAD
No obstante, quien invierte en este tipo de monedas digitales debe tener muy claro que esta forma trae consigo un elevado riesgo al capital, pues, así como puede haber un incremento, también puede tener inesperadamente un desplome y acabar con los ahorros de sus usuarios.
Para almacenarlas, los usuarios deben contar con un monedero digital o wallet, que en realidad es un software a través del cual es posible guardar, enviar y hacer transacciones de las criptomonedas. En realidad, este tipo de monederos sólo guarda las claves que marcan la propiedad y el derecho de una persona sobre cierta criptomoneda, por lo que estos códigos son los que en realidad se deben proteger.

articles.title: We're losing the night sky as light pollution makes it 10% brighter every year
articles.text:
Editor's take: I've always wanted to capture an image of the Milky Way galaxy – or, at the very least, see it with my own eyes in real time. I've got the photography know-how to pull off what would be a frame-worthy shot of our galaxy, as well as the desire to make it happen, but the opportunity simply hasn't presented itself yet. And if the statistics are to be believed, I might never get to cross this one off my bucket list.
Man-made light pollution is the culprit, and it's not just from above. You've no doubt heard of the growing headache that orbiting satellites are causing astronomers trying to photograph the night skies. Compounding the matter is the modern amenity that is artificial light on the ground. Thanks to technologies like LED lighting, large cities and neighborhoods are brighter than ever.
And we're not just talking small numbers here. According to one report, the average night sky got brighter by 9.6% per year from 2011 to 2022. That equates to a roughly doubling of the sky's brightness every eight years. Another study notes that four out of five people live under light-polluted skies. Given those odds, it's likely that you've never even seen the night sky as it was intended.
As Tove Danovich with The Guardian highlights, access to a dark sky is about more than just stargazing. Light pollution can confuse nocturnal animals that use moonlight to navigate, and being in a brightly lit environment around the clock can throw off the circadian rhythm of most all living creatures – humans included.
Some communities are already taking steps to reduce ground-based light pollution. Flagstaff, Arizona, has rules in place to regulate how much light can be used at night, what type, and where it can legally shine. New York state is also considering similar restrictions. But as Danovich correctly notes, such restrictions do nothing to combat space-based light pollution sources like satellites designed to beam sunlight to Earth at night.
Indeed, it feels like darkness is quickly becoming a luxury.

articles.title: Meta's Muse AI agent accused of accessing sensitive user data on iPhone and Mac without permission — agent shocks reporter by referring to confidential messages it wasn't granted access to
articles.text:
Meta's Muse AI agent accused of accessing sensitive user data on iPhone and Mac without permission — agent shocks reporter by referring to confidential messages it wasn't granted access to
Meta says Muse won't access data you tell it to ignore, but that doesn't appear to be true.
Meta's Muse is the hottest new AI agent in town right now after the company announced it earlier this month. But despite having been well-received by those who have put the agent through its paces since then, it now appears Muse might not be as private as Meta claims. The company has said that Muse was "built from the ground up to be a safe, secure, private, and widely available personal AI agent." But according to one report, Muse has been caught digging through thousands of personal messages without being given permission to do so.
Inc's Jason Aten has been putting Muse through its paces on two devices: a Mac mini and an iPhone. He says that he uses the Mac mini specifically as a place to test new agents like Muse, and once installed, he set about asking it to do some simple tasks. The agent said that it would be able to help him come up with new article ideas, which sounds just like something a journalist might want. But then Muse went rogue, suggesting a piece based on information it shouldn't have.
According to Aten, he was in conversation with a podcast cohost about the new iPhone 18 Pro and his decision to stick with last year's model. The conversation was in text form via the Messages app. That's when Muse popped up to suggest that the topic of discussion would make a good article. It offered to do some additional research on the subject, too. The problem was that Muse was never given permission to read Aten's messages.
When asked how it learned about the conversation, Muse claimed that the Mac version of the app was able to read incoming notifications. It then provided that context to the Meta iPhone app, which is where Muse made the article recommendation.
There had so far been no suggestion that this was possible, let alone something Muse was actually doing. Muse claimed that it wasn't reading Aten's actual messages, and that it didn't have access to chat histories. But Aten wasn't convinced.
After digging further, Aten was able to identify that Muse was indeed syncing a local Messages database. In fact, it was in the process of syncing all the way to row 187,462 of that database — suggesting Muse did have access to chat histories despite its protestations.
This, of course, is an issue. Aten confirmed that he didn't give Muse full disk access permissions on his Mac, something that should be required for the Messages database to be readable by the agent. Worse, David Singleton, the CEO of Meta Superintelligence Labs, responded to the situation with a thread of social media posts appearing to blame Aten for the situation.
Get Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.
At this point, it's unclear exactly how Muse gained access to Aten's Messages database. If Aten didn't accidentally give it access (which doesn't appear to be the case) there are obvious questions about what else Muse can access despite not being given permission to do so.
This isn't even the only Muse privacy and security issue to be put to Meta in the last 24 hours, either. It was also discovered that Muse can run terminal commands on its server host, which led to the discovery that the agent is powered by AMD EPYC Turin host systems. But because of that same access, it can potentially run unsafe commands, too.

Oliver Haslam has written about technology of all shapes and sizes for over 15 years, both online and in print. He's fascinated by how personal computing continues to change as tower PCs give way to foldable phones and beyond.
