articles.title: 'There’s a lot to like, just not the price' - why the LG Gram Pro 16 is almost perfect
articles.text:
TechRadar Verdict
The LG Gram Pro 16 is incredibly light, coming in at under three pounds. Yet, it has enough power to play demanding computer games (on scaled-down settings). The battery life is just as impressive. Too bad, the price tag is so high.
Reasons to buy
- +Under three pounds thanks to the use of a new type of material
- +Impressive performance considering the package
- +Long battery life
- +Has some interesting LG specific apps
Reasons to avoid
- -So expensive
- -Comes with McAfee
- -USB-C ports all on the same side
Why you can trust TechRadar
LG Gram Pro 16 review: Two Minute Review
Thin. Light. And a big screen. Say less. Add in a surprising amount of power for this form factor, and you have the LG Gram Pro 16. There’s a lot to like with this laptop, including some interesting LG-specific software and a very impressive battery life. The only thing that might give me pause in recommending it as one of the best laptops out there is its very high price.
Now, I should clarify that there is a version of the LG Gram Pro 16 that skips the Aerominum material of the pricier version (more on that later) and has the most basic integrated graphics instead of the Intel Arc B390 Graphics included on the configuration reviewed here. Even though the Intel Arc B390 Graphics in the review unit are also integrated, it’s surprisingly on par with an Nvidia GeForce RTX 4050.
So that version might be one of the best Ultrabooks out there for someone who wants that thin and light package with a big screen but doesn’t need all the bells and whistles. But that version pales in performance. Of course, the LG Gram Pro 16 reviewed here is much more expensive. I don’t want to tell you to wait for a sale, but its price is its biggest drawback.
LG Gram Pro 16 review: Price & Availability
- How much does it cost? Starting at $2,699.99 (about £2,010/ AU$3,830)
- When is it available? Available now
- Where can you get it? Available in the US
While the LG Gram Pro 16 is available in US, UK, and Australia, the 2026 configuration, which has the model designation of 16Z90U (or 16Z95U for the AMD powered ones), is mostly just available in the US at the time of writing. It most certainly will make it to the UK, and one configuration is sold in Australia with an MSRP of AU$4,199, though it’s already discounted to AU$2,899. This configuration comes with a Intel Core Ultra 7 355 CPU, 32GB RAM, Intel Arc graphics, and 1TB of storage. It also features a 2560x1600 touchscreen.
For the US, there are seven configurations. The cheapest one, not accounting for any slashed prices, goes for $2,699.99, which has an Intel Core Ultra 7 CPU and its integrated graphics, 32GB RAM, 512GB storage, and that same 2560x1600 touch screen. The price starts to creep up with more storage (though some models have a 1TB SSD but 16GB of RAM and are maybe fifty bucks more).
The most expensive model doesn’t have a touchscreen, but does have slightly higher resolution with a 2560x1800 screen. More importantly, it comes with an Intel Core Ultra X7 CPU, integrated Intel Arc graphics B390 Graphics which have the power of an Nvidia Geforce RTX 4050, 32GB of RAM and 1TB of storage.
The Samsung Galaxy Book6 Ultra is a good laptop to compare the LG Gram Pro 16 to. Its price tag of $2,449.99 / £2,999 (around AU$6,000) for a laptop with an Nvidia RTX 5060 GPU and 1TB of storage, similar CPU, and similar screen is also expensive, though less expensive than the LG Gram Pro 16 at its maxed out configuration. Or, if you look at the Dell 2026 XPS 16, you’ll find a very similarly priced and specced laptop that also comes with an OLED screen (again comparing to the max configuration).
Sign up for breaking news, reviews, opinion, top tech deals, and more.
I think there are a few reasons that LG costs more. The first is that they’re using a new material called Aerominum for the chassis, and semi-relatedly, weighs under three pounds, unlike either of the other mentioned laptops. Hopefully as LG keeps using Aerominum, the price will come down.
- Value score: 4 / 5
LG Gram Pro 16 review: specs
The LG Gram Pro 16 has about seven different configurations at the time of writing, all with slightly different combinations of CPU (Intel Core Ultra 7, AMD Ryzen AI 7 450, Intel Core Ultra X7), RAM (16 or 32GB), storage space (512GB, 1TB, or 2TB), and graphics, with the cheapest configuration utilizing the basic integrated Intel Graphics and more substantial configurations using the Ryzen AI 7 450’s integrated AMD Radeon 860M graphics or at the top of the price range, Intel’s integrated but powerful Arc B390 GPU.
| Header Cell - Column 0 | Base | Review / Max | 
|---|---|---|
| Price | $1,399.99 (about £1,040 / AU$1,980) | $3,499.99 (about £2,600 / AU$9,000) | 
| CPU | Intel Core Ultra 7 | Intel Core Ultra X7 | 
| GPU | Intel graphics | Intel Arc B390 Graphics | 
| RAM | 32GB LPDDR5X | 32GB LPDDR5X (Dual Channel, 8533MHz) | 
| Storage | 512GB M.2 SSD | 1TB M.2 SSD | 
| Display | 16-inch diagonal, WQXGA (2560x1600) touch IPS @120Hz | 16-inch diagonal, WQXGA+ (2560x1800) non-touch IPS @120Hz | 
| Ports and Connectivity | USB 3.2 Gen1 (x2), USB 4 Gen3x2 Type C (x2, with Power Delivery, Display Port, Thunderbolt 4), HDMI, Aux out | USB 3.2 Gen1 (x2), USB 4 Gen3x2 Type C (x2, with Power Delivery, Display Port, Thunderbolt 4), HDMI, Aux out | 
| Wireless | Intel Wi-Fi 7 (WiFi7, 2x2, BT Combo) and Bluetooth 6 | Intel Wi-Fi 7 (WiFi7, 2x2, BT Combo) and Bluetooth 6 | 
| Camera | FHD IR Webcam with Dual Mic (Face recognition) | FHD IR Webcam with Dual Mic (Face recognition) | 
| Dimensions | 2.97 lbs (1.35 kg) | 2.64 lbs (1.2 kg) | 
| Weight | 14.1 x 9.9 x 0.49~0.5 inches / 358.1 x 251.5 x 12.4~12.7 mm | 14.1 x 9.9 x 0.49~0.5 inches / 358.1 x 251.5 x 12.4~12.7 mm | 
On the exterior, there are two different screen options. The less powerful models come with a 2560x1600 resolution, some of which have touchscreens including the cheapest configuration. The more powerful ones with either the Ryzen or Intel Arc graphics have a slightly sharper 2560x1800 resolution – none of them touchscreen.
LG Gram Pro 16 review: Design
- Light, thin, but with a big screen!
- Keyboard doesn’t have much travel
- Good ports, but not ideal port placement
First things first, the LG Gram Pro 16 reviewed here is like all the other LG Grams, as it manages to be light and portable while still providing a pretty large screen. Those things are typically mutually exclusive. Yet here, you get a 16-inch screen in a package that weighs under three pounds. And since the bezels are pretty thin, it’s only fourteen inches wide. Plus, it’s half an inch thick.
It’s taken me a while to figure out why the LG Gram Pro 16 comes with such a high price tag. Part of it is the robust components. Part of it is the engineering to get it so light and thin. But part of it is, in my opinion, the use of a proprietary material called Aerominum instead of the usual aluminum alloy or plastic. It feels like plastic but is a little tougher, and the LG Gram Pro 16's chassis is made from it. There is, however, a little bit of give in the bottom shell where the venting is.
Since the LG Gram Pro 16 is so thin, the keyboard doesn’t have much travel. Because of this, I don’t really enjoy typing on it for long periods of time. It’s fine. It’s accurate. And it doesn’t bother me when browsing or more casual use, but it just doesn’t have much cushion. I can feel the keys bottom out on every press. At least, it’s a full size keyboard.
The trackpad, on the other hand, is nice to use. It’s also big, though I have to be careful to not accidentally touch it when typing as it is sensitive, and I’m somewhat lazy with my hand placement. And if you use all the different gestures Windows is capable of, the trackpad will register them.
Lastly, I’m appreciative of the port selection, but less so the port placement. A laptop like this doesn’t need anything beyond the two USB-4 type C, two USB, headphone jack, and an HDMI port that it comes with, but the LG Gram Pro 16 makes the same mistake that many laptops do. If you have two USB-C ports and that’s the only way to power the laptop, put one on each side and not on the same side. The power cable it comes with is not that long, and I’ve created a few tripping hazards trying to charge just because of the port placement.
- Design score: 4.5 / 5
LG Gram Pro 16 review: Performance
- Plenty of power for demanding tasks, though with some adjustments
- Mostly great suite of additional software
- Good audio, camera, and mic performance
3DMark: Solar Bay: 25,811; Steel Nomad: 1,607
Geekbench 7.0: (Single Core) 2,254; (Multi Core) 17,471
Crossmark: Overall: 1,981; Productivity: 1,763; Creativity: 2,334; Responsiveness: 1,716
HandBrake 1.11.1: 4:01
Total War: Warhammer III: Mirrors of Madness (1080p): 61.7fps; (2880x1800) 29.7fps
Cyberpunk 2077: (1080p, Ray Tracing): 18.29fps; (1080p, Ray Tracing off) 50.07fps
Battery Life (PCMark 10): 15:34:02
Between the Intel Core Ultra X7, Intel Arc B390 Graphics, and 32GB or RAM the LG Gram Pro 16 I’m reviewing has, it’s a fairly powerful computer. Despite the fact that the Intel Arc graphics are integrated and not actually a discrete GPU, it compares favorably to an Nvidia Geforce RTX 4050 (which is admittedly entry level for discrete graphics).
That means that I can take this somewhere to do a little work – maybe write this review, for instance – and then switch to a demanding video game like Starfield, South of Midnight or Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 for a bit of fun. While the computer struggles a little at the highest settings for these games, it’s also running at a 120Hz refresh rate.
Now, I assume that many people wanting to read about the LG Gram Pro 16 care about its gaming capabilities, but those are among the more demanding tasks you can ask from a computer. If it can run one of those games, it can handle photo and video editing (we also have benchmarks to show how they would handle those tasks). It can handle recording audio. This is a powerful computer, though, as a gaming computer, it just barely clears the bar of running those more demanding titles.
Now, since LG proudly advertises the AI capabilities of this laptop – if you look on the website, the thumbnail puts “AI” next to the computer’s name as if it’s part of it – it makes sense that AI is all over this thing.
When I open LG’s My Gram app, which is the LG Gram Pro 16’s software interface for fine-tuning its performance, I see things like AI microphone and speaker optimization settings (you can also register your voice so that the laptop only hears / recognizes it), AI cooling for the fan settings, and an AI mode for the battery settings where it adjusts battery usage based on what it’s learned about how one uses their computer and how to allocate battery based on that. The My Gram software can also turn off the screen automatically when you walk away from the laptop.
LG also includes its own LLM tool for interacting with the laptop: AI Gram Chat. Instead of letting you write prompts to generate an image or a short story, it is made as almost an interactive interface for the computer. I can ask it to summarize a document, change settings, or troubleshoot, to name just a few things it's capable of.
The unique software suite on the LG Gram Pro 16 isn’t limited to AI-focused apps. LG Gram Link is an interesting one that’s included, and lets you quickly share files with other compatible devices, like other LG Grams from 2021 and on, LG TVs and smart monitors, and mobile devices. You can download the LG Gram Link for both Android and iOS, so you’re not limited to an LG device.
The last thing worth mentioning on the software front is that, as interesting as those other apps are and as expensive as this computer can be, you’ll still be subjected to dealing with a free McAfee trial. Since I don’t use or like McAfee, it’s an annoyance with its constant pop-ups. And it’s a piece of software that makes you jump through hoops to uninstall. I don’t like it. Minus five points to LG.
For a laptop, the audio here is pretty good. There’s almost no low end to speak of, but that’s the case for most laptops. Content, whether it’s a movie or music, sounds clear without sounding harsh. If you want excellent audio, get some wireless headphones, but if you don’t have any, the speakers on this laptop are good enough.
Those who are stuck on video calls all day will be happy to know that the webcam looks pretty good. There’s some graininess in low light situations, which is to be expected, but the image is clear and smooth. Plus, you can do the auto framing where the camera zooms in on your face like a 70’s Western. The eye contact feature and background effects are also here. Just be aware that there’s no physical shutter to block the camera. And the built-in mic is similarly capable for Zoom and voice calls.
- Performance score: 4.5 / 5
LG Gram Pro 16 review: Battery life
- Very long battery life
- Has some AI features to extend battery life even longer
LG claims that the Gram Pro 16’s 77Wh battery can last for 27 hours when playing back video when using its AI Battery Efficiency feature). And it might just be able to do that. But I like to test battery life without any special features or tricks. I want to get a good sense of what the battery itself is capable of.
During use, it did in fact last quite a while. I was able to actually play computer games unplugged without running the battery completely down in an hour or two, though it did take a hit. And I would use it unplugged multiple days at a time without charging. Running the PCMark 10 battery benchmark for office use with all the settings midway between performance and battery took almost 17 hours. A chore to sit through, but a great indicator of how good the battery life is.
- Battery Life score: 4.5 / 5
Should I buy the LG Gram Pro 16?
| Attributes | Notes | Rating | 
|---|---|---|
| Value | If you compare the LG Gram Pro 16 to similarly specced laptops trying to do the MacBook Pro 16 thing, they’re all at the same somewhat hard-to-stomach price. | 4 / 5 | 
| Design | I might have some issue with a few choices on this laptop, but it’s thin and light while still offering a big screen. That’s hard to find. | 4.5 / 5 | 
| Performance | In that thin and light chassis is a pretty powerful computer, able to handle pretty powerful tasks along with its own AI apps. Just beware the McAfee popups. | 4.5 / 5 | 
| Battery Life | Even without LG’s battery efficiency, the battery on this laptop lasts a very long time. | 5 / 5 | 
| Final Score | If price is no object, the LG Gram Pro 16 is a very impressive computer. It’s the full packet (but a light one). | 4.5 / 5 | 
Buy it if…
You want thin, light, and powerful
This laptop comes in under three pounds and is half an inch thick, yet you can run a lot of demanding software on it.
You need long battery life
The LG Gram Pro 16 surprised me with its battery life, especially after experiencing its power. I think you’ll be surprised by it too.
You want to drag and drop files between devices
Using LG Gram Link, you can share files between devices. So, if you want to send a couple pictures from your phone to the laptop for editing, the app makes it simple.
Don't buy it if…
You have any budget concerns
The LG Gram Pro 16 is just priced too high. While I hazard to guess that it’s the use of a new type of material, its price tag is just out of reach for most people.
You don’t like McAfee
This is bloatware. Yes, it can be removed, but you get an added inconvenience to counteract the laptop’s actual conveniences like LG Gram Link.
LG Gram Pro 16 review: Also Consider
If our LG Gram Pro 16 review has you considering other options, here are two laptops to consider...
Samsung Galaxy Book6 Ultra
Thin. Light. With a 16-inch screen. Sound familiar? Well, the Samsung Galaxy Book6 Ultra checks those boxes too. Plus, it’s similarly expensive. However, it does come with more powerful graphics (and a bigger issue with heat).
Read our full Samsung Galaxy Book6 Ultra review
Dell XPS 16 (2026)
The Dell XPS 16 is a premium laptop that’s thin and light with a big screen like the LG Gram Pro 16. Plus, it comes with an OLED screen for about the same price. Its port selection is a bit more limited, however, and it’s a pound heavier.
Read our full Dell XPS 16 (2026) review
How I tested the LG Gram Pro 16
- Tested for a couple weeks
- Used it for work, gaming, and streaming
- Messed with its AI capabilities
I used the LG Gram Pro 16 for a couple weeks. I used it for work, including typing up most of this review (along with the requisite online research). I used it to stream video. I even did some serious gaming. I also played around with the AI and first-party software.
After spending time with the LG Gram Pro 16, it’s clear that this is meant for those who want a large screen in a thin, light package without sacrificing power. That might be a big ask, but LG has done it for a price.
I’ve spent the last few years reviewing tech gear for gaming and otherwise, where I’ve gotten a feel for what to look for and how to put a piece of kit through its paces to see whether it’s worth the recommendation.
- First reviewed: August 2026
James Holland loves checking out gadgets of all sorts, whether it's audio equipment, laptops, or vacuums (especially of the robot variety), and does so for a number of Future Publications including TechRadar, Top Ten Reviews, Homes & Gardens, and T3. He's built up an expertise for in-depth reviewing over the last four years. When he's not putting in the work on the latest tech, he loves to travel, play music, and eat questionable food.

articles.title: Ce robot-tondeuse intègre un capteur pour repérer les hérissons
articles.text:
Anthbot R7 : un bras coupe-bordures pour s'attaquer aux finitions de la pelouse
Un fil à la patte
Avec ses R720 et R730, Anthbot vise les grands jardins et les terrains accidentés. Au programme la marque a mis quatre roues motrices et une navigation mêlant plusieurs capteurs et un bras coupe-bordures pour limiter les retouches manuelles.
Anthbot R7
Une fois le robot tondeuse rentré à sa base, il reste souvent une bande d'herbe le long des obstacles. Anthbot entend s'attaquer à cette corvée avec sa série R7 et le système EdgeEase présenté lors de l'IFA. Nous avons pu voir son bras équipé d'un coupe-bordures à fil, qui ajuste sa position pour suivre les contours irréguliers du jardin. Une caméra dédiée accompagne son fonctionnement.
La marque promet une coupe jusqu'au bord, sans retouche manuelle. Il faudra vérifier en pratique comment le dispositif se comporte au pied des murs, autour des plantations ou dans les angles. Première distinction à retenir : le bras est fourni avec le R730, mais proposé en option sur le R720.
Les deux modèles disposent de quatre roues motrices. Leur système compte six moteurs dont quatre pour la propulsion et deux pour la direction. Anthbot annonce des pentes franchissables jusqu'à 40° ainsi que des obstacles verticaux de 7 cm. La tonte repose sur deux disques flottants conçus pour suivre les irrégularités du terrain. La largeur de coupe atteint 32 cm, avec une hauteur réglable de 3 à 7 cm depuis l'application. Le R720 est recommandé pour 2000 m2, contre 3000 m2 pour le R730.
Hérissons sous surveillance
Pour se repérer, la navigation HoloSense combine un lidar à 360°, un second lidar fixe, trois caméras avec analyse d'image et un positionnement satellitaire RTK. L'objectif est de croiser plusieurs sources d'information pour circuler dans les jardins complexes et détecter les obstacles.
Le R730 ajoute aux caméras et aux lidars un capteur infrarouge destiné à détecter les signaux thermiques d'animaux cachés dans l'herbe, notamment les hérissons. Le R720 ne disposerait pas de cet équipement selon la fiche technique.
Les batteries offrent un rendement de 570 et 600 m2/h, avec une recharge en 60 minutes dans les deux cas. Les deux robots comportent également des capteurs de pluie, de température et d'humidité.
Anthbot R7

articles.title: Avant même sa sortie, l'iPhone Duo s'apprête à chambouler le marché des pliables : les chiffres
articles.text:
Apple débarque tard sur le marché des smartphones pliables, mais les analystes lui promettent déjà une place de choix. Seule ombre au tableau : des usines qui peinent à suivre…
Les précommandes de l’iPhone Duo, présenté en grande pompe par la marque à la pomme le 9 septembre dernier, ouvriront le 16 octobre. Vendu à partir de la maudite somme de 2 339 euros, l’appareil arrive sur un segment encore très modeste, puisque les pliables ne représentent qu’environ 2 % des smartphones vendus dans le monde. Dans ce contexte, combien d’exemplaires Apple peut-elle espérer écouler ?
Un quart du marché dès la première année
Une estimation chiffrée vient en effet de tomber. Selon Counterpoint Research, qui suit trimestre par trimestre les livraisons de tous les grands fabricants de smartphones, Apple devrait livrer environ 6 millions d’iPhone Duo d’ici à la fin de l’année. Petite précision, ce chiffre fait référence aux appareils expédiés aux revendeurs et aux opérateurs, pas encore achetés par les clients.
Mais rapporté au marché, ce volume pèse lourd, explique Bloomberg. Le géant californien s’emparerait ainsi d’environ 25 % des livraisons mondiales de pliables en 2026. De quoi se hisser directement à la deuxième place, derrière Samsung (38 %) mais devant Huawei (22 %). Le tout avec à peine dix semaines de commercialisation.
L’arrivée d’Apple profiterait d’ailleurs à tout le segment. IDC, autre grand nom des études de marché, table sur 22,9 millions de pliables livrés cette année au total, soit une hausse de près de 13 % en glissement annuel. Sans l’iPhone Duo, le marché aurait au contraire reculé de plus de 10 %.
Le défi se joue sur les lignes d’assemblage
Mais ces projections reposent sur une condition essentielle : la production. Car atteindre les 6 millions d’unités dépend de la vitesse à laquelle Apple montera en cadence. Le chiffre fait donc figure de plafond plutôt que de moyenne. Les autres estimations vont dans le même sens, avec 5 millions pour TrendForce et 6 millions pour l’analyste Jeff Pu.
Ces volumes restent modestes à l’échelle d’Apple. Par exemple, un iPhone Pro se vend habituellement à 20 ou 30 millions d’exemplaires sur l’ensemble de sa carrière. Pour le marché des pliables, en revanche, c’est un séisme.
Mais la tâche s’annonce délicate sur les lignes d’assemblage. Chez Foxconn, le principal sous-traitant d’Apple, à peine plus de 60 % des appareils assemblés auraient passé les contrôles qualité à la mi-septembre. De même, les écrans pliables fournis par Samsung Display et la charnière, composée de plus de 100 pièces, auraient aussi pris du retard. Il faudrait encore environ six mois pour tourner à plein régime.

articles.title: Intel "Nova Lake" Launch Nears as Platform Passes USB4 and PCIe 5.0 Compliance Testing
articles.text:
Wednesday, September 30th 2026
	
									
	
	
	
Intel "Nova Lake" Launch Nears as Platform Passes USB4 and PCIe 5.0 Compliance Testing
Intel's Core Ultra 400-series "Nova Lake" CPUs are reportedly nearing launch as Intel has successfully passed USB and PCIe compliance testing. This means the platform has officially passed testing with the two organizations, and all the advertised specifications are working correctly. Starting with the USB Implementers Forum (USB-IF), a governing body of the USB standard, there are two "Nova Lake-H" device IDs certified for compliance with USB4. These include devices with IDs D331 and D333. Additionally, USB-IF lists ID 6E6E for the "Nova Lake" PCH-S chipset for desktop motherboards, compliant with USB 3.2 Gen 2. Intel likely chose a desktop chipset and a laptop CPU to achieve Qualification by Similarity, where testing one product can earn certification for other products easily. To avoid revealing too much before the launch, Intel opted for this strategy instead of testing a full flagship desktop CPU.
For the PCI-SIG, a governing body for PCIe compliance, Intel's 900-series chipset has long been present with the IDs 6E38-6E3F, 6E30-6E35, and 6E40-6E47. These were added back in April, but in August, another set of entries for CPUs specifically appeared. Certifying the PCIe 5.0 x16 root complex were device IDs D461, D465, and D467-D46A, which are likely "Nova Lake-S" CPUs or some mobile variation. Regardless, the verification process is the final stage that a platform and the CPU usually go through before the launch is finalized.The timeline for the "Nova Lake-S" rollout is rumored to follow, with mass production set to begin in Q4 2026, and the first SKUs arriving in Q1 2027. The initial edition of "Nova Lake-S" will feature a 28-core, single-compute die SKU, while the flagship 52-core version remains undefined for now. Intel has only indicated that this powerful SKU will be available on desktops within 2027.

articles.title: The iPhone Duo is reportedly facing production challenges with low yields and quality concerns
articles.text:
Bottom line: After years of rumors and speculation, Apple's first foldable iPhone is expected to go on sale next month, but getting enough of them into customers' hands could prove the harder part. Foxconn, the contract manufacturer responsible for producing the device, is reportedly facing severe production constraints that could limit early output, raising the prospect of tight supply for what is now Apple's most expensive iPhone.
According to an insider quoted by Chinese outlet Jiemian News, final assembly yields for the iPhone Duo were only slightly above 60% as of September 17. It could take Foxconn another six months to a year to raise yields to more mature levels while maintaining Apple's exacting quality standards.
The insider added that Foxconn has been continuously adjusting equipment, assembly processes, and production settings as it tries to bring yields up to acceptable levels. Suppliers are also reportedly lobbying Apple to ease certain quality requirements to speed up production and meet expected demand.
What makes matters worse is that the problems extend well beyond Foxconn. According to the report, several suppliers are also experiencing production issues, with Samsung Display singled out as one of the worst affected. The company is reportedly struggling with low yields for its foldable OLED panels and hinges, largely due to last-minute design changes by Apple.
Another supply chain source claimed that Apple's total production target for the iPhone Duo in 2026 is between six and eight million units, much lower than the 20 to 30 million units an iPhone Pro or Pro Max typically ships over its full product cycle. A separate source reportedly said Apple's sales guidance for the iPhone Duo is in excess of five million units.
According to a separate report from MyDrivers, several suppliers have told Apple it might have to choose between yield and output, as the entire iPhone Duo manufacturing ecosystem is facing serious production issues. The report, however, did not reveal the identities of any of the suppliers urging Apple to lower its quality standards to meet output targets.
The sources explained that ramping up production under the current constraints might improve output, but at the cost of yield, with the number of defective units expected to skyrocket, especially if Apple is unwilling to compromise on quality. Higher output would therefore result in higher scrap costs, which may not be in Apple's best interest.
Apple unveiled the iPhone Duo earlier this month at its 'Surprise and Shine' event in Cupertino, California. The device starts at $1,999 for the base 256GB model, lower than the $2,500+ range some analysts had predicted, and similar to the $2,099 asking price of the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra.

articles.title: Grab this 10-port gigabit PoE+ switch with up to 60W of power for under $38, a new record low — Ugreen switch upgrades your home network with eight power-delivery ports for cameras and Wi-Fi extenders
articles.text:
Grab this 10-port gigabit PoE+ switch with up to 60W of power for under $38, a new record low — Ugreen switch upgrades your home network with eight power-delivery ports for cameras and Wi-Fi extenders
Unlock super-fast speeds for your network with up to 60W of power delivery
If you want to expand your home network with cameras, WiFi extenders, and other smart home tech, you'll want to invest in a good power-over-Ethernet switch. At the minute, a Ugreen 10-port PoE+ switch is on sale for just $37.79 on Amazon. That's a new record low for this model, and it unlocks eight extra PoE+ ports (and 10 in total) for your network, at a price that's much more affordable than many of its rivals.
● Check out this deal on Amazon
Ugreen is a brand that you'll see a lot on Amazon, from network gear like this to wall chargers and peripherals. It's budget-focused, with reasonable prices that hide some pretty well-designed hardware. Here, you're getting a 10-port switch that supports the PoE+ standard (IEEE 802.3at), which means it can deliver up to 30W of power for devices on each individual port.
In practice, that means you can hook up newer and much faster devices to this switch, with power and data both being delivered over a single Ethernet cable. The switch supports 60W in total using a cascade system. If the power draw hits 60W, it'll shut down ports to prevent overload, starting from port 8 to port 1, so you can prioritize the ports you want and need the most. The switch will automatically detect PoE devices, so it won't short out a normal device like your PC or laptop by accident. Extended power delivery mode means that you can connect devices as far as 820 feet away, too.
The Ugreen 10-port PoE+ network switch offers Gigabit speeds and 30W per-port of power over each Ethernet cable across eight different ports, with two ports used as uplink ports for data connection to your main network.
If you're building a smart home network with plenty of devices to power, a switch like this will prove useful. This particular Ugreen switch is unmanaged, so there isn't a huge setup process to work through, and it should work immediately when you plug it into your existing hardware. That does mean it'll lack some of the extra customization that a more expensive managed switch could offer, but for most users, the ease of use will be the bigger draw anyway.
Almost any Ethernet-ready device will work with this switch, even if they aren't able to take advantage of its power delivery. Laptops, PCs, NAS drives, printers, TVs, game consoles, IP cameras, and more will work with this switch.
You're also getting the bonus of speed here. This Ugreen switch delivers gigabit speeds across your network, so you can leave WiFi latency and lag issues far behind when you're playing games or streaming Netflix shows. Ethernet connections using this switch will help you max out the bandwidth from your ISP. You've also got two uplink ports which you can hook up to your existing network for the best bandwidth.
The $37.79 sale price for this 10-port Ugreen switch is a great one, but it's only around for a limited-time only. If you want to pick up this fanless, lightning-protected, compact Gigabit PoE+ switch, you'll need to get your order in before the deal runs out.
Ben Stockton is a deals writer at Tom’s Hardware. He's been writing about technology since 2018, with bylines at PCGamesN, How-To Geek, and Tom’s Guide, among others. When he’s not hunting down the best bargains, he’s busy tinkering with his homelab or watching old Star Trek episodes.

articles.title: Plus de 19 000 films : la justice française s'en prend à l'hébergeur OVH pour bloquer deux sites pirates
articles.text:
Le tribunal judiciaire de Paris a ordonné à OVH, dans un jugement du 17 septembre 2026, d’empêcher l’accès depuis la France à deux sites pirates de films et de séries hébergés sur son infrastructure. La mesure, réclamée par Columbia Pictures, Disney, Netflix, Universal et deux autres sociétés américaines, doit être en place au plus tard 15 jours après la signification du jugement. Elle durera 18 mois, aux frais de l’hébergeur.
C’est l’hébergeur qui est visé ici, et non les fournisseurs d’accès à internet (Orange, SFR, Free, Bouygues Telecom), cibles habituelles de ce type de demande. L’information a d’abord été relayée par Univers Freebox. Le texte du jugement permet d’en préciser la portée.
Un blocage fondé sur l’article L. 336-2
Les studios ont assigné OVH le 4 juin 2026 selon la procédure accélérée au fond, sur la base de l’article L. 336-2 du code de la propriété intellectuelle. Ce texte permet au juge d’ordonner des mesures à l’encontre de « toute personne susceptible de contribuer à y remédier ». Avec l’accord des parties, l’affaire a été jugée sans audience.
Les deux sites concernés s’appellent « tekfullfilmizle » et « fullhdfilmizlesene ». Des agents assermentés de l’ALPA ont constaté qu’ils s’adressent à un public francophone. Le premier donnait accès sans autorisation à 2 611 films et 175 séries, le second à 19 738 films. Sur un échantillon de 15 liens vérifiés à la main pour chaque site, 14 renvoyaient vers des œuvres contrefaisantes, soit un taux annoncé de 93,33 % pour chacun, avec une marge d’erreur annoncée d’environ 3,4 %.
Le tribunal relève aussi que ces sites n’affichent aucune des mentions légales exigées par la loi pour la confiance dans l’économie numérique et qu’ils sont intégralement anonymisés via plusieurs prestataires. Pour les juges, cela tend à montrer que leurs exploitants connaissent le caractère illicite des liens, et cela rend difficile de les poursuivre directement.
Ce que doit faire OVH, et ce qu’il n’a pas à faire
OVH doit empêcher l’accès depuis le territoire français, outre-mer compris, aux noms de domaine et sous-domaines listés dans une annexe du jugement. Le moyen est laissé à son choix. OVH doit informer les studios dès que le blocage est en place, et ces derniers doivent lui signaler les domaines qui disparaissent, pour éviter des coûts inutiles.
Si les sites changent de nom de domaine ou de chemin d’accès, les studios pourront revenir devant le tribunal, en procédure accélérée au fond ou en référé, pour faire actualiser la mesure. Le jugement est exécutoire malgré un éventuel appel.
Les demandeurs voulaient davantage : un délai de cinq jours, la possibilité de suspendre les services d’hébergement des exploitants, un rappel du rôle de l’Arcom pour les sites miroirs et 15 000 euros de frais de justice. Le tribunal a retenu 15 jours et le blocage des noms de domaine. Il n’a pas repris la mention de l’Arcom dans son dispositif, et il a rejeté les demandes financières des deux côtés, OVH réclamant de son côté 5 000 euros. Chaque partie garde ses dépens.
Ce que disait OVH
OVH contestait le caractère contrefaisant des deux sites, jugeait les mesures disproportionnées et s’opposait à un blocage étendu à toute autre adresse IP. Le tribunal a estimé les constats de l’ALPA suffisamment probants. Il rappelle qu’il doit ménager un équilibre entre le droit d’auteur, la liberté d’entreprise des intermédiaires et la liberté d’information, en citant deux arrêts de la Cour de justice de l’Union européenne, et il écarte tout contrôle général et sans limite de durée.
Une question reste ouverte
Le jugement demande à OVH d’empêcher l’accès aux deux sites depuis la France « par tout moyen efficace », en citant notamment le blocage des noms de domaine. Les studios réclamaient aussi la possibilité de suspendre les services d’hébergement des exploitants, une option que le dispositif ne reprend pas expressément. Il vise par ailleurs des « abonnés » d’un contrat souscrit en France, une notion qui pourrait renvoyer plus naturellement aux fournisseurs d’accès qu’à un hébergeur. Comment OVH, qui héberge les serveurs, mettra concrètement le blocage en œuvre n’est pas précisé par la décision.

articles.title: TGC 2026: Students pitch Maharashtra's innovation roadmap to CM Fadnavis
articles.text:
TGC 2026: Students pitch Maharashtra's innovation roadmap to CM Fadnavis
Six finalist teams from ISB, IIM Mumbai, IIT Bombay and more present deep tech solutions to CM Devendra Fadnavis at the Summit Round of The Governance Challenge 2026, India's first governance-focused competition.
What would it take for Maharashtra to become India's innovation hub by 2035? Six teams of business and public policy students are putting their answers directly to Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis today.
The fourth edition of The Governance Challenge (TGC), billed as India's first governance-focused competition, reaches its Summit Round on 30 September at the Jamshed Bhabha Theatre, NCPA, Mumbai. The six finalists were whittled down from 4,429 teams over three months of competition.
A 2035 brief with a deep tech lens
This year's edition is hosted by the Government of Maharashtra and supported by the Gates Foundation. Its theme, Catalysing Innovation, came with a single question for participants: what can the state government do to make Maharashtra an innovation hub by 2035?
The brief builds on moves the state has already made. These include the Maharashtra Startup, Entrepreneurship and Innovation Policy 2025, the Rs 500 crore Chief Minister MahaFund, and the proposed Maharashtra Innovation City.
Teams were asked to push further, with a particular focus on deep tech. Solutions had to target one of six domains: agriculture, healthcare, education, governance, financial inclusion, and urban development.
TGC runs annually across 30 business and public policy institutions. Earlier editions partnered with the governments of Haryana, Odisha, and Uttar Pradesh.
Record turnout at the campus stage
The competition opened with a Campus Round in August 2026. It drew the largest participation in TGC's history: 4,429 teams and 13,287 students across the 30 institutions.
After evaluation, each institution picked one Campus Winner to move on to the Nationals Round.
Bureaucrats and domain experts on the jury
On 11 and 12 September, the 30 Campus Winners presented virtually to a jury pairing a senior state official with a domain expert for each of the six domains.
The jury shortlisted six teams for the Summit. The same 12 members then mentored the finalists they had selected, helping them sharpen their proposals before today's presentations.
Six finalists, one stage
The teams presenting today come from Indian School of Business, BITS School of Management, SJMSOM at IIT Bombay, Masters' Union, IIM Mumbai, and IIM Ranchi.
They pitch to CM Fadnavis, joined by Rajesh Aggarwal, Chief Secretary of Maharashtra, and Deepak Karanjikar, Member of the Governing Council of the Maharashtra Institute for Transformation.
The top three teams will share a prize pool of Rs 9 lakh. They also receive certificates and individual pre-placement interview opportunities with Samagra.
Why it matters
TGC gives students a rare line of sight into how policy is actually made, and gives the state a pipeline of fresh ideas vetted by the officials who would implement them. With the MahaFund and Innovation City already in motion, today's pitches land at a moment when Maharashtra is actively shaping its innovation agenda.
The competition is organised by Samagra, a governance consulting firm that works only with governments. It partners with senior political and bureaucratic leaders at the state and national levels on systemic reforms, using technology and data to improve delivery across education, agriculture, skilling, employment, health, and public services.

articles.title: Disney+ a retiré le HDR sans baisser son prix : Que Choisir demande réparation
articles.text:
Disney+ continue de facturer son offre Premium 15,99 euros par mois malgré la disparition de plusieurs fonctions liées à la qualité d’image. Que Choisir Ensemble a donc mis Disney en demeure de rétablir ses prestations, de revoir son tarif ou de compenser les abonnés concernés. Une démarche qui s’inscrit dans une contestation plus large en Europe, où des associations de consommateurs allemandes et néerlandaises ont déjà alerté les abonnés.
Cinq euros séparent chaque mois les offres Standard et Premium de Disney+, facturées respectivement 10,99 et 15,99 euros. Ce supplément donne notamment accès à quatre écrans simultanés et au Dolby Atmos, mais aussi à la meilleure qualité d’image proposée par la plateforme.
Or, plusieurs de ces avantages ont disparu au fil de l’année. Le Dolby Vision a commencé à être retiré au début de 2026, suivi peu après par d’autres formats HDR. La 4K a ensuite été supprimée cet été avant d’être partiellement rétablie grâce à une solution reposant sur le codec VP9. Ce retour reste toutefois limité à certains équipements et ne permet pas de restaurer le HDR.
Que Choisir demande à Disney de revoir son offre Premium
Le prix de l’abonnement n’ayant pas suivi la même trajectoire, Que Choisir Ensemble a adressé une mise en demeure à Disney. L’association demande à la plateforme de remettre son offre Premium en conformité ou, à défaut, d’en diminuer le prix. Elle réclame également une information claire des abonnés concernés, une compensation « proportionnée, objective et uniforme », ainsi que la fin de toute présentation commerciale susceptible de les induire en erreur.
Disney affiche désormais davantage de précautions sur son site, avec des formulations comme « jusqu’à la 4K Ultra HD ». Mais l’association estime que les clients déjà abonnés ont été informés tardivement et de manière incomplète. Certains auraient obtenu un dédommagement après avoir contacté le service client, sans qu’une politique générale de compensation ait été mise en place.
À l’origine de ces restrictions se trouve toujours le conflit de brevets opposant Disney à InterDigital. Le directeur juridique de cette dernière affirme que les deux groupes ont négocié pendant plusieurs années avant que son entreprise ne saisisse différentes juridictions. Disney a depuis cherché à contourner certaines technologies concernées, notamment en utilisant le VP9 pour rétablir une partie de la 4K.
Ce contournement pourrait toutefois ne pas clore le dossier : InterDigital conteste désormais également l’utilisation du VP9 par Disney pour rétablir l’Ultra HD sur certains appareils.
Une contestation qui dépasse largement la France
La démarche française n’est pas isolée. En Allemagne, la Verbraucherzentrale avait déjà invité les abonnés concernés à demander un remboursement partiel en raison de la dégradation de l’offre Premium.
Aux Pays-Bas, l’association Consumentenbond a de son côté publié un article expliquant aux abonnés qu’ils pouvaient, selon leur situation, réclamer une réduction. Elle souligne notamment les restrictions ayant touché la 4K et le HDR, mais aussi la disparition de Chromecast et les problèmes rencontrés avec AirPlay, sans baisse du prix de l’abonnement Premium.
Lors de notre précédent point sur le dossier, à la mi-septembre, la France n’était pas concernée par les restrictions touchant Google Cast et AirPlay en Allemagne et aux Pays-Bas. À ce stade, Disney n’a pas publiquement répondu à la mise en demeure de Que Choisir Ensemble.
Cette dernière ne constitue pas une condamnation de la plateforme. Elle déplace néanmoins le dossier sur un terrain beaucoup plus concret pour les abonnés français : celui des cinq euros supplémentaires réclamés chaque mois pour une formule Premium dont plusieurs avantages techniques ont disparu ou ne sont revenus que partiellement.

articles.title: Florida attorney general asks judge to bar OpenAI from developing new AI models without third-party approval — OpenAI says it already paused training its most capable models last week
articles.text:
Florida attorney general asks judge to bar OpenAI from developing new AI models without third-party approval — OpenAI says it already paused training its most capable models last week
Florida's motion uses OpenAI's own safety warnings as evidence
Florida Attorney General (AG) James Uthmeier has filed a motion for a temporary injunction against five OpenAI entities and Sam Altman personally over questions about AI safety. It asks the court to order several enjoinments against OpenAI: for the company to stop developing any AI models without independent third-party guardrails and approval, to stop providing ChatGPT for minors in Florida, to stop collecting data from Florida children under 13 without notice, consent, review, and security procedures, to stop representing ChatGPT as safe, accurate, or reliable, to stop ascribing any false human attributes to its services, and to stop soliciting engagement through “conversation prolongation.”
In a video posted to X the same day, Uthmeier said Altman can join the request if his intentions are genuine.
The motion is part of Florida’s original lawsuit against OpenAI and Altman, filed in June in Highlands County after the state reviewed the accused Florida State University gunman’s ChatGPT logs. It alleges deceptive and unfair trade practices (FDUTPA), negligence and gross negligence, design defect, failure to warn, fraudulent misrepresentation, and public nuisance. Uthmeier called it the first state-led lawsuit against the company and its CEO.
The motion covers multiple recent, well-known events related to the company and potential safety lapses, including the Hugging Face hack from July, the Australian Medicare statistics portal unauthorized access incident, and more. OpenAI posted six misalignment reports earlier this month, not including one for the Australian incident, although those are a small portion of the tens of thousands of incidents OpenAI and competitor Anthropic are reportedly investigating.
The motion also quotes multiple people at OpenAI in its call for actoin. Paul Christiano, a new OpenAI board member, said this month that he sees “a meaningful risk” of catastrophic and irreversible loss of control in the very near term, and that OpenAI isn’t on track to reduce it to an acceptable level. Chief scientist Jakub Pachocki wrote in an essay days earlier: “I believe broader interventions are required.” And at the UN Security Council last week, Altman said that OpenAI “should not train models” unless it can make “an extremely strong case” that they can be kept under human control.
On Friday, before the motion was filed, OpenAI reported that “all training, evaluation, and inference with tool-use (defined broadly) of our most capable models remain paused” after an agent reached a public chatbot through a DNS gap in its training sandbox. In a statement about the motion on Monday, company spokesperson Drew Pusateri said the company will resume training “only when we are confident that we have additional safeguards in place.” In particular, the company wants policies that cover “the entire AI industry — not just one company,” with governments playing an important role. This is the second pause in less than three months.
For now, the pause is OpenAI’s own call, but it follows recent public calls to slow the pace of AI development. Training may resume under the company’s own internal safeguards, but Florida wants an independent third party to sign off for as long as the case runs. Whether a Florida court can influence model development outside of the state is a separate question. The FDUTPA provision for an injunction cited by the motion is “effective throughout the state,” but the motion wouldn't seem to hold force beyond state lines.
Get Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.
OpenAI had attempted to move the case to federal court in the Southern District of Florida, but Judge Aileen Cannon sent it back: the defendants “clearly fail[ed] to satisfy the requirements” for federal jurisdiction. The motion argues that under FDUTPA, the AG needs to show only a “clear legal right” to relief, through likely success on the merits.
OpenAI’s response to this motion will likely be viewed under a harsh light. The company and others in the AI industry have come under heightened scrutiny as agent capabilities have increased. Florida's ongoing lawsuit follows a slew of others, and the breadth of the enjoinments it requests against the company is serious and far-reaching. Concerns about AI’s influence and impact on children continue to spark debate, too.
These concerns are not limited to OpenAI or any one AI company: rival Anthropic’s IPO filing reportedly warns that AI may pose existential risks to humanity, the same kind of warning Florida’s motion levels against OpenAI.

articles.title: Alarmierende Google-Zahlen: KI verdoppelt entdeckte Sicherheitslücken
articles.text:
Google-Analyse zeigt Verdopplung von Softwareschwachstellen durch KI
Die Google Threat Intelligence Group hat einen aktuellen Bericht zur Cybersicherheit veröffentlicht. Darin dokumentiert die Analyseeinheit eine Verdopplung der gemeldeten Softwareschwachstellen innerhalb weniger Monate.
Im Januar 2026 registrierte Google noch 5.045 sogenannte Vulnerability Disclosures, während die Zahl im August bereits auf 10.740 anstieg. Wie der Bericht weiter ausführt, spielt der Einsatz von Künstlicher Intelligenz bei dieser Entwicklung eine zentrale Rolle.
KI-Agenten finden veränderte Fehlerprofile
Sicherheitsforscher:innen nutzen zunehmend autonome KI-Agenten, um komplexe Systeme auf Schwachstellen zu prüfen. Diese Werkzeuge decken strukturell andere Arten von Fehlern auf als herkömmliche Scanner.
Laut der Analyse führen 50 Prozent der durch KI gefundenen Fehler zu einer Remotecodeausführung, bei der Angreifer:innen Code aus der Ferne ausführen können. Bei klassisch aufgespürten Lücken liegt dieser Anteil bei lediglich 26 Prozent.
Die Google-Einheit erklärt diesen Unterschied damit, dass Forschungsteams ihre KI-Werkzeuge gezielt auf kritische Infrastrukturen und Speicherfehler ansetzen. Die Systeme können tiefergehende logische Fehler in Programmiersprachen wie C identifizieren, die statische Analysetools übersehen.
Einfluss von Anbieterzyklen auf die Daten
Die reine Anzahl der gemeldeten Schwachstellen wird laut dem Google-Bericht allerdings auch durch automatisierte Meldeprozesse beeinflusst. So verursachte allein der Begriff „Linux Kernel“ im laufenden Jahr rund 5.000 Einträge, ohne dass in diesem Zusammenhang eine einzige ausgenutzte Zero-Day-Schwachstelle registriert wurde.
Gleichzeitig sorgten konzentrierte Patch-Veröffentlichungen einzelner Anbieter für Spitzenwerte in der Statistik. Im August 2026 stammten 128 der als hochriskant eingestuften Schwachstellen aus den vierteljährlichen Updates des Technologieunternehmens Oracle aus dem US-Bundesstaat Texas sowie aus Netzwerktreiber-Advisories für Linux.
Beschleunigte Ausnutzung von N-Days
Neben der reinen Entdeckung verändert sich auch die Ausnutzung der Schwachstellen durch böswillige Akteur:innen. Die Zahl der ausgenutzten Zero-Day-Lücken, für die es noch keine Fehlerbehebung gibt, stieg laut dem Bericht nur leicht von durchschnittlich acht auf elf pro Monat an.
Deutlich stärker wuchs hingegen die Ausnutzung von Fehlern mit hohem Risiko, sogenannten N-Days, die bereits bekannt und oft auch gepatcht sind. Hier stieg die Zahl der ausgenutzten Lücken von 28 im gesamten Jahr 2025 auf 75 zwischen Januar und August 2026.
Die Studienautor:innen vermuten, dass Angreifer:innen große Sprachmodelle einsetzen, um Produktversionen und Patch-Informationen automatisiert abzugleichen. Auf dieser Basis lassen sich bekannte Schwachstellen schneller in funktionsfähige Exploits umwandeln.
Die Angriffe konzentrieren sich dabei weiterhin auf Perimeter-Appliances und exponierte Unternehmensdienste. Edge-Gateways stellen laut der Analyse einen primären Vektor für den initialen Zugriff dar.
Mehr als 65 Prozent der ausgenutzten Schwachstellen an diesen Netzwerkrändern fielen in die Kategorien mit hohem oder kritischem Risiko. Angreifer:innen zielen dabei primär auf unauthentifizierte, öffentliche Verwaltungsschnittstellen ab, um die blinden Flecken von Unternehmenssoftware auszunutzen.
KI-Infrastruktur als eigenes Ziel
Der Google-Bericht beleuchtet zudem Schwachstellen in der KI-Infrastruktur selbst. Von Januar 2025 bis August 2026 zählte die Analyseeinheit in diesem Bereich 2.076 gemeldete Fehler.
Über 1.500 dieser Meldungen entfallen allein auf das laufende Jahr, wobei Orchestrierungs-Frameworks wie Langflow etwa die Hälfte der Fälle ausmachen. Diese visuellen Workflow-Builder beinhalten oft Knotenpunkte zur Codeausführung, die durch gezielte Eingaben manipuliert werden können.
Inferenz-Server im Fokus der Angreifer:innen
Wie Siliconangle berichtet, nutzen Angreifer:innen hier Techniken wie Prompt-Injections, um über die Systeme Schadcode einzuschleusen. Darüber hinaus verzeichnete Google 212 Meldungen zu Inferenz- und Serving-Software wie vLLM und Ollama.
Fast ein Viertel dieser Fehler ließ sich auf unauthentifizierte Programmierschnittstellen oder fehlerhafte Anfragenfälschungen auf der Serverseite zurückführen. Bislang hat die Google Threat Intelligence Group jedoch noch keine Zero-Day-Ausnutzung dieser KI-Infrastruktur beobachtet.
Wenn Schwachstellen in KI-Middleware ausgenutzt werden, geschieht dies zumeist bei Systemen, die ungeschützt aus dem Internet erreichbar sind. In einem Fall dokumentierte das kalifornische Cybersicherheitsunternehmen Sysdig einen autonomen Ransomware-Angriff, der über eine ältere Schwachstelle in Langflow eindrang.
Solche zentralisierten KI-Gateways stellen eine doppelte Bedrohung dar. Einerseits legen kompromittierte Systeme Schnittstellenschlüssel und private Datenströme offen, andererseits dienen sie als initialer Ankerpunkt, um seitwärts in interne Cloud-Umgebungen einzudringen.
Neues Vorgehen beim Patch-Management
Aus den gesammelten Daten leitet die Analyseeinheit konkrete Empfehlungen für IT-Abteilungen ab. Das klassische, unpriorisierte Massen-Patching ist den veränderten Zeitabläufen demnach nicht mehr gewachsen.
Stattdessen rät das Unternehmen dazu, Fehlerbehebungen auf Basis aktueller Bedrohungslagen zu priorisieren. Ein gezielter Schutz an den Netzwerkrändern bilde dabei die betriebliche Grundlage.
Softwareanbieter sollten zudem eigene KI-gestützte Code-Reviews durchführen, bevor sie Produkte ausliefern. Dadurch ließe sich das Wachstum der öffentlich gemeldeten Schwachstellen langfristig eindämmen.

articles.title: Trabajadores crean perfiles falsos con IA para ser contratados: el nuevo reto para las empresas
articles.text:
Perfiles falsos generados con inteligencia artificial están infiltrándose en procesos de selección de empresas de todo el mundo. Candidatos que nunca existieron, o que ocultan su identidad real detrás de un filtro digital, logran superar entrevistas por videollamada y acceder a sistemas internos con credenciales legítimas.
El fenómeno, que hasta hace poco se consideraba un problema exclusivo de recursos humanos, se transformó en una vía de intrusión para las áreas de seguridad. Según la firma de investigación Gartner, uno de cada cuatro postulantes a un empleo será falso hacia 2028.
PUBLICIDAD
Cómo operan los candidatos falsos generados con IA
Crear una identidad ficticia para una entrevista remota exige, hoy, muy poco esfuerzo técnico. Basta con una imagen estática o un video breve de otra persona y unos segundos de su voz para construir un rostro sintético capaz de moverse y hablar en tiempo real durante una videollamada.
Vijay Balasubramaniyan, director ejecutivo de la firma de autenticación de voz Pindrop Security, describió el ritmo del fenómeno como “sin precedentes” y afirmó haber detectado personalmente a un candidato con estas características.
Una encuesta de la plataforma de empleo Resume Genius, realizada entre mil responsables de contratación en Estados Unidos, encontró que el 17% de ellos se topó con postulantes que usaron tecnología deepfake para alterar su apariencia durante una entrevista en video.
PUBLICIDAD
Los estafadores no se limitan al video. Con inteligencia artificial también generan currículums, fotografías profesionales, sitios web personales y perfiles de LinkedIn que, combinados, arman lo que parece el candidato perfecto para el puesto.
Un candidato deepfake es una persona que utiliza inteligencia artificial para alterar su rostro o voz durante una entrevista laboral remota, con el fin de ocultar su identidad real y superar los filtros de selección de una empresa, generalmente para acceder a sistemas internos o cometer fraude.
Cuáles son los riesgos que enfrentan las empresas
Una vez dentro de la organización, estos falsos empleados pueden robar secretos comerciales o instalar programas maliciosos en la infraestructura de la compañía. El acceso resulta legítimo, porque fue la propia empresa quien lo otorgó sin saber a quién tenía del otro lado de la pantalla.
PUBLICIDAD
El caso con mayor repercusión pública involucra a redes vinculadas a Corea del Norte. En mayo de 2024, el Departamento de Justicia de Estados Unidos denunció que más de 300 empresas estadounidenses habían contratado, sin saberlo, a impostores conectados con ese país para cubrir puestos remotos de tecnología de la información.
Esas contrataciones generaron, según la denuncia, al menos 6,8 millones de dólares en ingresos para el régimen norcoreano. Los trabajadores usaron identidades robadas de ciudadanos estadounidenses y redes virtuales privadas para ocultar su ubicación real.
El organismo estima que este tipo de esquemas producen cientos de millones de dólares al año, con buena parte de esos fondos destinados al Ministerio de Defensa de Corea del Norte y a su programa de misiles nucleares.
PUBLICIDAD
El consultor en seguridad informática Roger Grimes señaló además un efecto colateral: la sola sospecha de estar ante un candidato falso puede hacer que postulantes reales pierdan oportunidades laborales, porque el proceso de selección se vuelve más largo, más costoso y más desconfiado.
Métodos para detectar un candidato falso
Vidoc Security Lab sufrió dos veces entrevistas con postulantes falsos. En una, viral en LinkedIn, Moczadlo pidió al candidato poner la mano frente a su rostro para romper el filtro de inteligencia artificial. Ante su negativa, cortó la entrevista. Desde entonces, la empresa exige encuentros presenciales de un día, con viaje y jornal pagados.
CBS News sumó otras señales: verificar la fecha de creación de un perfil de LinkedIn y sus conexiones reales, o hacer preguntas culturales que solo un residente genuino podría responder.
PUBLICIDAD
André Naef, de Validato, sostuvo que verificar la identidad real de un candidato “ya no es un trámite de RR. HH., es una medida de seguridad”. La firma recomienda reforzar controles en contrataciones remotas con acceso a datos sensibles, aunque advierte que el uso de biometría requiere un análisis jurídico previo por su carácter de alto riesgo.
PUBLICIDAD

articles.title: Arnold Schwarzenegger tenía una finca valorada en más de medio millón. Terminó formando parte de una ruta natural
articles.text:
Cuando pienso en Arnold Schwarzenegger mi mente lo imagina como el T-800 de Terminator. A mí me cuesta sacar al actor fuera de los entornos peliculeros, pero su vida va mucho más allá de personajes apocalípticos. En el mundo real, y aparte de gobernar California, Schwarzenegger hizo una contribución importante para salvar un entorno natural de ese preciso estado.
La propiedad. Corría 2016, y Schwarzenegger se juntó con Betty Weider, culturista y empresaria, para donar cerca de 16 hectáreas de una finca ubicada en Zuma Canyon, California. Esa parcela terminó integrándose en el Backbone Trail, una extensa ruta de senderismo que serpentea por los patrajes naturales de las montañas de Santa Mónica. No fue una donación cualquiera: la finca se había tasado en más de 500.000 dólares, unos 440.000 euros sin contar la inflación.
Con el terreno donado, la ruta pudo cruzar por Zuma Canyon y abrir así el entorno natural a cualquiera que se calce unas botas de senderismo (o una bicicleta, que buena parte de la senda es apta para BTT). Como destaca el Servicio de Parques Nacionales (NPS), el diseño final del Backbone Trail es el resultado de más de cuatro décadas de colaboración entre organismos públicos, privados, activistas y mecenas. Como nuestro Schwarzy.
Pumas, reptiles y un santuario biológico. Los Ángeles es una ciudad gigantesca, de esas donde el único bosque está hecho de hormigón. Cuesta imaginar que esté pegada a un paraje natural donde habitan todo tipo de especies animales y vegetales, pero así es. Por Santa Mónica puedes pasear y encontrarte un puma, poca broma.
Los animales amenazados necesitan amplio espacio libre y que este no se vea interrumpido por autopistas, edificios y otras construcciones. La creación de un sendero como el Backbone Trail no solo aportó una vía para pasear y disfrutar de la naturaleza, también otorgó refugio a todo tipo de especies autóctonas. Como los propios pumas, coyotes, ciervos, multitud de aves y reptiles.
Más de 40 años para acabar el proyecto. La historia del Backbone Trail comenzó mucho antes de que se implicaran Arnold Schwarzenegger y Betty Weider. Según detalló el NPS en 2016, hacer realidad la ruta necesitó más de 40 años de gestiones. En los años sesenta, las montañas de Santa Mónica estaban salpicadas de ranchos privados, campos de golf y urbanizaciones. Hubo que negociar los terrenos finca a finca.
En conjunto, se adquirieron más de 180 parcelas con un coste que terminó superando los 100 millones de dólares (unos 88 millones de euros al cambio actual, sin contar la inflación). Dicho coste se sufragó mediante fondos locales y programas federales, además de con donaciones como las de Schwarzenegger y Weider. Hoy en día es una ruta con una longitud de 67 millas (casi 108 kilómetros). El tramo del Backbone Trail junto a Zuma Canyon recibe más de 10.000 visitantes al año.
Un activista medioambiental. Durante su mandato como gobernador de California entre 2003 y 2011, Schwarzenegger hizo del medioambiente uno de los ejes de su agenda. En 2006 promulgó la Global Warming Solutions Act, una normativa que fijó metas estrictas para la emisión de gases de efecto invernadero. Esto sentó las bases legislativas de California en materia de cambio climático.
Tras abandonar la política, el actor continuó vinculado a las causas medioambientales: cofundó la organización R20 (Regions of Climate Action) para orientar a los gobiernos hacia planes sostenibles y promovió la creación del USC Schwarzenegger Institute en 2012. Permanecerá para siempre en mi memoria como Terminator, pero en su trayectoria confluyen el cine, la política y la filantropía. Su donación de suelo en 2016 es una de las huellas más tangibles.

articles.title: MediaTek aux commandes : les Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra et Tab S12+ de Samsung font leurs débuts avec un tarif plus premium que jamais
articles.text:
MediaTek aux commandes : les Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra et Tab S12+ de Samsung font leurs débuts avec un tarif plus premium que jamais
Samsung met à jour son offre de tablettes avec les Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra et Tab S12+. Au programme, la nouvelle puce MediaTek Dimensity 9500, mais aussi des tarifs en nette hausse.
Deux tablettes, sinon rien. On se disait bien qu’il manquait quelque chose au catalogue de Samsung, qui n’avait rien annoncé sur le front des tablettes en 2026. Comme on pouvait donc s’y attendre, le sud-coréen renouvelle (une partie de) sa gamme d’ardoise avec deux modèles : les Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra et Galaxy Tab S12+. Pour l’heure, aucune Tab S12 n’est prévue, et c’est la Galaxy Tab S11 de l’an dernier qui officie en tant qu’appareil le moins onéreux de la famille.
Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra
Pour sa Tab S12 Ultra, Samsung mise toujours sur un format extrêmement généreux, pensé pour la performance et la productivité. La marque équipe donc son appareil d’un écran de 14,6 pouces - c’était la diagonale d’écran de la Tab S11 Ultra de 2025 - promettant cette année encore une luminosité maximale de 1600 cd/m² en pic. Statu quo également au niveau du format, la nouvelle venue conservant les dimensions de son aînée et son poids de 692 g, mais aussi à celui de la batterie, maintenue à 11 600 mAh.
Quelles nouveautés, dans ces conditions ? L’essentiel concerne la puce qui anime l’appareil, à savoir le nouveau MediaTek Dimensity 9500, synonyme de performances graphiques annoncées en hausse, si on les compare à celles de la Tab S11 Ultra, munie d’un Dimensity 9400+.
La Tab S12+ apporte davantage de fraîcheur à sa gamme, puisqu’elle succède en réalité à la Galaxy Tab S10+, de 2024 ; la génération Tab S11 avait en effet fait l’impasse sur la version “+”, privilégiant un format 11 pouces plus compact. La S12+ hérite d’un écran de 12,6 pouces, plus grand donc que celui de sa devancière (12,4 pouces), malgré un boîtier légèrement plus grand (187,8 x 289,5 mm), mais aminci à 5,6 mm. Son poids s’allège à 553 g, contre 571 g pour la Tab S10+, malgré l’intégration d’un accumulateur de 10 600 mAh (contre 10 090 mAh). Pour le reste, la Tab S12+ fait jeu égal avec le modèle Ultra, puisqu’elle adopte la même puce, et est livrée avec le même S Pen. On retient que le modèle “+” n’a pas droit à deux modules photo dorsaux et troque le wifi 7 de l’Ultra contre du wifi 6e, mais que les deux tablettes sont certifiées IP68. Toutes deux sont assorties d’un multifenêtre amélioré, d’un mode DeX optimisé, de fonctions IA mises à l’honneur (Now Nudge fait ses débuts sur tablettes) et incluent quelques applications pensées pour leur format, dont le tout récent Photoshop.
Samsung Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra
Des prix en hausse, comme partout
Les deux tablettes sont annoncées à des prix en hausse, comme la majorité des appareils tech du marché. Il faut tout de même compter un minimum de 1539 € pour la Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra 12/256 Go, soit 200 € de plus que la Tab S11 Ultra à configuration égale. Pour la Tab S12+, il faut compter un minimum de 1319 € (12/256 Go). Des configurations 5G, avec davantage de stockage, sont dédiées aux budgets les plus généreux.

articles.title: Galaxy S25 Ultra registra queda abrupta de preço e tem 59% OFF na Amazon • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Galaxy S25 Ultra registra queda abrupta de preço e tem 59% OFF na Amazon
Galaxy S25 Ultra (256 GB) traz câmera de 200 MP, corpo de titânio e desempenho de sobra; celular premium da Samsung tem preço mais baixo com pagamento no Pix
O Galaxy S25 Ultra de 256 GB está saindo por R$ 4.958 no Pix na Amazon. O celular premium da Samsung com câmera de 200 MP que filma em 8K, corpo de titânio e chip Snapdragon de ponta, recebe desconto de 59% sobre o preço original de R$ 11.999 e fica bem abaixo da média recente.
Um dos destaques do Galaxy S25 Ultra é seu kit traseiro de câmeras, que filma em 8K a até 30 fps. Ele traz wide de 200 MP com OIS, ultrawide de 50 MP e telefotos de 10 MP e 50 MP com zoom óptico de 3x e 5x, respectivamente. A frontal de 12 MP tira ótimas selfies e por sua vez filma em 4K a 60 fps.
Outro destaque é seu corpo de titânio ultrarresistente, enquanto o sucessor S26 Ultra usa alumínio na construção. O vidro Gorilla Armor 2 reveste o gadget de 2025 de ambos os lados e resiste a arranhões e pancadas, e a certificação IP68 confere proteção em cenários como poeira intensa e mergulhos acidentais.
Sua tela AMOLED Dinâmico 2X de 6,9″ possui taxa de 120 Hz e brilho de até 2.600 nits, sendo capaz de reproduzir cores excelentes com alta fluidez em apps e games, além de garantir visibilidade confortável em qualquer ambiente.
O chip Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite e 12 GB de RAM dão ao S25 Ultra grande poder de fogo para rodar apps pesados em multitarefa, games e soluções do Galaxy AI localmente. Os 256 GB de armazenamento permitem guardar uma quantidade adequada de vídeos e fotos.
Sua bateria de 5.000 mAh resiste a até 31 horas de reprodução de vídeo, segundo a fabricante. O suporte ao carregamento rápido de 45 W via USB-C e de 15 W sem fio garante o uso por tempo prolongado, ideal para usuários com agendas corridas.
O Galaxy S25 Ultra de 256 GB (R$ 4.958 no Pix) foi atualizado para o Android 16 e é elegível a mais seis updates do sistema operacional. O celular da Samsung possui conectividade 5G, Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 5.4 e NFC.
Aviso de ética: ao clicar em um link de afiliado, o preço não muda para você e recebemos uma comissão.

articles.title: Microsoft Launches Windows 11 26H2 Update
articles.text:
Wednesday, September 30th 2026
	
									
	
	
	
Microsoft Launches Windows 11 26H2 Update
Microsoft today released its latest Windows 11 26H2 update, bringing a new milestone for Windows 11 users. In this release, Microsoft is highlighting a few features that Windows 11 25H2 users have not yet experienced. These include a smarter File Explorer with new capabilities such as summarization, additional archive formats, and AI productivity enhancements. Additionally, Windows Search has been improved to prioritize searching through your files before resorting to web searches, while also handling typos and partial application names more effectively. Frequently used folders will receive automatic indexing, making them easier to find. Other optimizations include updates to Magnifier with new zoom and screen tint options, Narrator adding a Braille Viewer, and Voice gaining a wider range of voice-driven commands on Copilot+ PC. Finally, the Start menu and Taskbar now offer new customization options, positioning changes, and a smaller view option.
Interestingly, this update focuses more on resetting the support cycles that Microsoft is implementing, rather than introducing major features or overhauls. For those upgrading, the main change will be an extension of the support cycle as users transition to the 26H2 release. Starting September 29, 2026, there will be 36 months of servicing support for Enterprise and Education editions of Windows 11, version 26H2. Home and Pro editions will receive 24 months of support.Since late 2024, support and updates have been rolled out across every OS branch, with each new release cycle activating these features rather than leaving them dormant in the kernel. Enablement packages (eKB) are central to this process, as downloading an update essentially involves eKBs that activate certain functionalities. For instance, on a device running Windows 11 24H2 or 25H2, a simple eKB is needed to upgrade to the latest Windows 11 26H2 version. For older versions like 22H2 and 23H2, which are on an older servicing branch, Windows 11 26H2 is a full feature update.

articles.title: You can now play the original Halo in your browser, 128-player multiplayer included
articles.text:
First look: Halo: Combat Evolved can now be played in a web browser, complete with its full single-player campaign and a multiplayer mode built for up to 128 players. The project arrives just days after the 2001 shooter was decompiled, giving developers a new base for ports, modifications and other technical experiments, like this one.
This browser Halo "release" shows how quickly recovered game code can become a working project, even when the original was built for a fixed console platform.
Created by Mitchell Hynes, the browser version runs a port of the original game through a standard web browser rather than a console or traditional PC installation. It includes the campaign from start to finish, along with online multiplayer.
The campaign appears to be the more stable part of the project. Early hands-on reports say it runs well in Google Chrome and closely matches the original Xbox release. Hynes has mapped the original Xbox Duke controller's controls to a mouse-and-keyboard setup, letting the game play like a conventional PC shooter while preserving the original control logic.
That is a notable shift for a game built around fixed console hardware. The first Halo was developed for the original Xbox, where the hardware, controller and operating system were tightly controlled. Running it in a browser introduces a different technical environment, including browser-based input handling, graphics processing and network communication.
 – Mitch (@mitchellhynes) September 29, 2026
The new multiplayer mode is the more ambitious part of the project. The original game was built around split-screen play, local system-link sessions and smaller multiplayer groups.
Supporting 128 players requires a far larger networking setup, with the game handling player movement, weapons, vehicles and combat events across many connected clients. Reports so far suggest the multiplayer mode has been less reliable than the campaign.
The project follows the recent decompilation of Halo: Combat Evolved. For older games, decompilation – the reconstruction of software into code that developers can inspect and modify – can open the door to new ports, performance improvements, expanded modding tools and changes that were not possible through traditional fan patches.
In Halo's case, the decompilation has already prompted discussion around uncapped frame rates, more extensive mods and additional platform support. The browser version is an early example of what can happen when a classic game becomes easier for outside developers to adapt.
Browser ports have become more common for older games in recent years. Fan-made browser versions have appeared for Grand Theft Auto: Vice City, the original Diablo and Half-Life. These projects vary in scope, but they share the same basic goal: making older games accessible through modern hardware and software without requiring the platforms they originally shipped on.
Other recent decompilation efforts are moving in a similar direction. Super Mario Galaxy has been fully decompiled, with a PC port in development. Work on the Nintendo DS title Kingdom Hearts 358/2 Days is also progressing toward a playable PC release.
The legal status of these projects remains unclear. Decompilation and fan ports can raise copyright issues, particularly when they involve full commercial games. Microsoft, Nintendo and Square Enix could challenge projects based on their games, and the projects' continued availability is not guaranteed.

articles.title: When is the best time to buy an Amazon Echo Show? And what price should I wait for? Here's everything you need to know
articles.text:
When is the best time to buy an Amazon Echo Show? And what price should I wait for? Here's everything you need to know
It's Show time
Thinking of buying an Amazon Echo Show? The best time to do it is during an Amazon Prime Day sale. It's a safe bet that the vast majority of Amazon devices — including Echo Shows — will be heavily discounted during these events, and it's very rare to see these kinds of price-drops at any other time of year.
Nowadays, we have two Prime Days every year: one around July and one around October. And of course they don't just last a day. That would be silly. You can expect at least two days of deals, and maybe more. The next Amazon Prime Day is imminent: it's scheduled to run on 6 and 7 October.
Traditionally, you had to be a Prime subscriber to take advantage of the Prime Day deals. That's still sort-of the case, but increasingly we're seeing 'Prime Day' pricing appearing ahead of the official events, and the deals are open to everyone. That's the case this year with the Echo Show range (as well as a bunch of other Amazon devices, actually).
• Shop Amazon's full US early Prime Day sale / UK early Prime Day sale
There are significant discounts live already across almost the entire Echo Show range in both the US and the UK. I've rounded up all the current pricing directly below, or you can scroll down further for more information on the deals — including how they compare to previous offers — and my advice on how to choose.
US links
UK links
Amazon Echo show: buying advice
Normal bargain-hunting rules dictate you should wait for a product to return to the cheapest price it has ever dropped to, before now. However, in the case of Prime Day, Amazon does like to switch things up. For instance, the most recent Prime Day was in June 2026; the deals appearing now aren't exactly the same, and in some cases prices are slightly higher than we saw in June.
However, I'd still recommend buying the model you want now, as I don't expect prices to drop any further during this event. Unless, of course, you wanted to gamble and wait until the next Prime Day to see if your desired model gets a bigger discount. (Risky tactics because in general, prices are trending up.)
What's slightly sneaky is that Amazon has increased the list price alongside those discounts, to make the deal appear better than it is. For instance, in the US the Echo Show 11 has fallen to the same price it was in June: $149.99. However, because Amazon has raised the 'original' price, it's showing as a 40% discount now, whereas in June it was only 32% off.
For reference, here are all the discounts and list prices for the June 2026 Prime Day. I'll start with the US:
- Show 5: $59.99 (list price $89.99) — 33% off
- Show 8: $124.99 (list price $179.99) — 31% off
- Show 11: $149.99 (list price $219.99) — 32% off
- Show 15: $249.99 (list price $299.99) — 17% off
- Show 21: $319.99 (list price $399.99) — 20% off
And here were the deals in the UK:
- Show 5: £49.99 (list price £89.99) — 44% off
- Show 8: £114.99 (list price £179.99) — 36% off
- Show 11: £139.99 (list price £219.99) — 36% off
- Show 15: £239.99 (list price £299.99) — 20% off
- Show 21: List price £399.99 — no discount
Which one should I buy?
I assume if you've got this far, you know what an Amazon Echo Show is and what it's for. But just in case: these are speakers / displays that act as hubs from which you can control your smart home. The different options range in capabilities and screen size — the number at the end of the product name indicates the size of screen.
If you want the biggest and best screen, you should buy the Show 21, which has a 21-inch, full HD display. The Show 15 and Show 11 also have full HD screens, but they're smaller.
If price is your main consideration, it's the littlest option that comes in cheapest. The Echo Show 5 is very compact, and less than half the price of the next model up. However, there are concessions you're making for that low price: the display isn't HD, there's one basic speaker and the camera is only 2MP.
You might get better value for money by opting for an Echo Show 8 or 11, which both offer a jump up in specs compared to the Show 5. Both have two full-range drivers and a 2.8-inch woofer, plus a 13MP camera with auto-framing. The 8 has a HD display and the 11 has full HD.
